    import FreeCADGui as Gui
    Gui.SendMsgToActiveView("ViewFit")
    Gui.activeDocument().activeView().viewIsometric()
except:

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import math

def create_cable_stayed_bridge():
    """Create a detailed cable-stayed bridge using FreeCAD API"""
    
    doc = App.newDocument("CableStayedBridge")
    
    # Water and riverbanks
    def create_water_and_riverbed():
        # Water
        water = Part.makeBox(500, 150, 20)
        water.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-250, -75, -40)
        water_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Water")
        water_obj.Shape = water
        water_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.25, 0.41, 0.88, 0.7)  # RoyalBlue with transparency
        
        # Riverbed
        riverbed = Part.makeBox(500, 150, 10)
        riverbed.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-250, -75, -50)
        riverbed_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Riverbed")
        riverbed_obj.Shape = riverbed
        riverbed_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.96, 0.64, 0.38)  # SandyBrown
    
    # Abutments - improved and repositioned for longer bridge
    def create_abutments():
        for x_pos in [-280, 280]:  # Moved further out for longer bridge
            # Main abutment body - much more substantial
            outer_box = Part.makeBox(80, 120, 60)
            outer_box.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 40, -60, -30)
            
            inner_box = Part.makeBox(50, 90, 40)
            inner_box.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 25, -45, -20)
            
            # Create hollow abutment
            abutment = outer_box.cut(inner_box)
            
            # Add substantial wing walls
            wing1 = Part.makeBox(30, 25, 50)
            wing1.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 55, -60, -25)
            wing2 = Part.makeBox(30, 25, 50)
            wing2.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 55, 35, -25)
            
            # Add approach slab
            approach_slab = Part.makeBox(40, 100, 8)
            approach_slab.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 20, -50, -8)
            
            final_abutment = abutment.fuse([wing1, wing2, approach_slab])
            
            abutment_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Abutment_{x_pos}")
            abutment_obj.Shape = final_abutment
            abutment_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.75, 0.75, 0.75)  # Concrete gray
    
    # Main tower (A-frame design with proper volume and strength)
    def create_tower():
        tower_parts = []
        
        # Massive tower legs - much thicker and more substantial
        for y_pos in [-30, 30]:
            # Create thick, tapered concrete legs
            # Bottom section - very thick foundation
            bottom_section = Part.makeCone(12, 8, 40)  # Large base tapering up
            bottom_section.Placement.Base = App.Vector(0, y_pos, -20)
            tower_parts.append(bottom_section)
            
            # Middle section 
            middle_section = Part.makeCone(8, 6, 50)
            middle_section.Placement.Base = App.Vector(0, y_pos, 20)
            tower_parts.append(middle_section)
            
            # Top section
            top_section = Part.makeCone(6, 4, 35)
            top_section.Placement.Base = App.Vector(0, y_pos, 70)
            tower_parts.append(top_section)
        
        # Cross bracing between legs - ELEVATED to clear highway traffic
        # NO lower cross brace - keep highway clear!
        
        # Middle cross brace - elevated above traffic clearance (minimum 5.5m clearance)
        middle_brace = Part.makeBox(14, 55, 10)
        middle_brace.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-7, -27.5, 55)  # Raised from 45 to 55
        tower_parts.append(middle_brace)
        
        # Upper cross brace
        upper_brace = Part.makeBox(12, 45, 8)
        upper_brace.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-6, -22.5, 80)  # Raised from 75 to 80
        tower_parts.append(upper_brace)
        
        # Add diagonal cross bracing instead of blocking horizontal brace
        # This provides structural strength without blocking traffic
        for side in [-1, 1]:
            diagonal_brace = Part.makeBox(8, 4, 50)
            diagonal_brace.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-4, side * 15, 20)
            # Rotate to create diagonal
            diagonal_brace.Placement.Rotation = App.Rotation(App.Vector(1, 0, 0), 30 * side)
            tower_parts.append(diagonal_brace)
        
        # Cable support saddle at top - CRITICAL for cable attachment
        cable_saddle = Part.makeBox(20, 70, 15)
        cable_saddle.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-10, -35, 100)
        tower_parts.append(cable_saddle)
        
        # Add cable attachment points on the saddle
        for y_attach in [-25, 25]:
            attachment_point = Part.makeCylinder(3, 8)
            attachment_point.Placement.Base = App.Vector(0, y_attach, 105)
            tower_parts.append(attachment_point)
        
        # Foundation spread footing
        foundation = Part.makeBox(25, 80, 8)
        foundation.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-12.5, -40, -28)
        tower_parts.append(foundation)
        
        # Add diagonal struts for A-frame geometry
        for y_side in [-1, 1]:
            strut = Part.makeCone(3, 2, 60)
            strut.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-8 * y_side, 20 * y_side, 25)
            # Rotate to create diagonal
            strut.Placement.Rotation = App.Rotation(App.Vector(0, 1, 0), 15 * y_side)
            tower_parts.append(strut)
        
        # Fuse all tower parts
        tower = tower_parts[0]
        for part in tower_parts[1:]:
            tower = tower.fuse(part)
        
        tower_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "MainTower")
        tower_obj.Shape = tower
        tower_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.85, 0.85, 0.85)  # Concrete gray
    
    # Bridge deck with completely open ends for traffic flow
    def create_bridge_deck():
        # Main cable-stayed span (center section only)
        main_span_length = 360  # Just the cable-stayed portion
        
        # Main box girder - only the cable-stayed section
        outer_girder = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 60, 12)
        outer_girder.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, -30, 0)
        
        inner_cutout = Part.makeBox(main_span_length - 10, 48, 8)
        inner_cutout.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-175, -24, 2)
        
        box_girder = outer_girder.cut(inner_cutout)
        
        # Bottom stiffener plate
        bottom_plate = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 40, 3)
        bottom_plate.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, -20, -3)
        
        # Combine girder and stiffener
        deck_structure = box_girder.fuse(bottom_plate)
        
        # Add longitudinal stiffeners
        for y_offset in [-15, 0, 15]:
            stiffener = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 2, 8)
            stiffener.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, y_offset - 1, 4)
            deck_structure = deck_structure.fuse(stiffener)
        
        deck_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "BridgeDeck")
        deck_obj.Shape = deck_structure
        deck_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)  # Gray
        
        # Road surface - only on cable-stayed span
        road_surface = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 50, 2)
        road_surface.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, -25, 12)
        
        # Create slight crown for drainage
        crown_cut = Part.makeCylinder(48, main_span_length + 2)
        crown_cut.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-181, 0, 12)
        crown_cut.Placement.Rotation = App.Rotation(App.Vector(0, 1, 0), 90)
        
        road_with_crown = road_surface.cut(crown_cut)
        
        road_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "RoadSurface")
        road_obj.Shape = road_with_crown
    # Connected approach spans - seamlessly joined to main deck
    def create_approach_spans():
        """Create approach bridge spans connected to main deck"""
        
        # Left approach span - CONNECTED to main deck at x=-180
        left_approach_deck = Part.makeBox(120, 60, 12)  # Match main deck dimensions
        left_approach_deck.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-300, -30, 0)  # Same height as main deck
        
        # Hollow out left approach (match main deck design)
        left_cutout = Part.makeBox(110, 48, 8)
        left_cutout.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-295, -24, 2)
        left_approach_deck = left_approach_deck.cut(left_cutout)
        
        # Left approach road surface
        left_approach_road = Part.makeBox(120, 50, 2)
        left_approach_road.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-300, -25, 12)  # Same height as main road
        
        # Left approach support columns
        left_columns = []
        for x_col in [-280, -240]:  # Positioned to support the span
            for y_col in [-15, 15]:
                column = Part.makeCylinder(4, 32)
                column.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_col, y_col, -32)
                left_columns.append(column)
        
        # Combine left approach
        left_approach = left_approach_deck.fuse(left_approach_road)
        for col in left_columns:
            left_approach = left_approach.fuse(col)
        
        left_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "LeftApproachSpan")
        left_obj.Shape = left_approach
        left_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)  # Match main deck color
        
        # Right approach span - CONNECTED to main deck at x=+180
        right_approach_deck = Part.makeBox(120, 60, 12)  # Match main deck dimensions
        right_approach_deck.Placement.Base = App.Vector(180, -30, 0)  # Same height as main deck
        
        # Hollow out right approach
        right_cutout = Part.makeBox(110, 48, 8)
        right_cutout.Placement.Base = App.Vector(185, -24, 2)
        right_approach_deck = right_approach_deck.cut(right_cutout)
        
        # Right approach road surface
        right_approach_road = Part.makeBox(120, 50, 2)
        right_approach_road.Placement.Base = App.Vector(180, -25, 12)  # Same height as main road
        
        # Right approach support columns
        right_columns = []
        for x_col in [200, 240]:  # Positioned to support the span
            for y_col in [-15, 15]:
                column = Part.makeCylinder(4, 32)
                column.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_col, y_col, -32)
                right_columns.append(column)
        
        # Combine right approach
        right_approach = right_approach_deck.fuse(right_approach_road)
        for col in right_columns:
            right_approach = right_approach.fuse(col)
        
        right_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "RightApproachSpan")
        right_obj.Shape = right_approach
        right_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)  # Match main deck color
        
        # Create transition joints between spans
        create_deck_joints()
        
        # Create approach spans - separate simple beam bridges
        create_approach_spans()
    
    # Stay cables - updated for shorter main span
    def create_stay_cables():
        cable_parts = []
        
        # Cable attachment height on tower saddle
        tower_attachment_height = 108  # On top of the cable saddle
        
        # Only create cables for the main cable-stayed span
        for x in range(-160, 161, 25):  # Reduced range for main span only
            if abs(x) < 15:  # Skip cables too close to tower
                continue
                
            for y_side in [-1, 1]:
                # Tower attachment point - ON THE SADDLE
                tower_y = 25 * y_side  # Attachment points on saddle
                
                # Deck attachment point
                deck_y = 28 * y_side
                
                # Create cable as proper 3D geometry
                start_point = App.Vector(0, tower_y, tower_attachment_height)
                end_point = App.Vector(x, deck_y, 12)
                
                # Calculate cable direction and length
                direction = end_point.sub(start_point)
                length = direction.Length
                
                if length > 0:
                    # Create cable as cylinder
                    cable_radius = 0.8 if abs(x) > 80 else 0.6  # Thicker cables for longer spans
                    cable_cylinder = Part.makeCylinder(cable_radius, length)
                    cable_cylinder.Placement.Base = start_point
                    
                    # Rotate cylinder to align with cable direction
                    z_axis = App.Vector(0, 0, 1)
                    cable_direction = direction.normalize()
                    
                    # Calculate rotation
                    if not z_axis.isEqual(cable_direction, 1e-6):
                        if z_axis.isEqual(cable_direction.negative(), 1e-6):
                            # 180 degree rotation
                            cable_cylinder.Placement.Rotation = App.Rotation(App.Vector(1, 0, 0), 180)
                        else:
                            # Normal case
                            axis = z_axis.cross(cable_direction)
                            angle = math.acos(min(1.0, max(-1.0, z_axis.dot(cable_direction))))
                            cable_cylinder.Placement.Rotation = App.Rotation(axis, math.degrees(angle))
                    
                    cable_parts.append(cable_cylinder)
                    
                    # Add cable end fittings at tower
                    tower_fitting = Part.makeSphere(1.5)
                    tower_fitting.Placement.Base = start_point
                    cable_parts.append(tower_fitting)
                    
                    # Add cable end fittings at deck
                    deck_fitting = Part.makeSphere(1.2)
                    deck_fitting.Placement.Base = end_point
                    cable_parts.append(deck_fitting)
        
        # Combine all cables
        if cable_parts:
            cables = cable_parts[0]
            for cable in cable_parts[1:]:
                cables = cables.fuse(cable)
            
            cables_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "StayCables")
            cables_obj.Shape = cables
            cables_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.9, 0.9, 0.9)  # Light gray for steel cables
    
    # Median barrier and guardrails - only on main cable-stayed span
    def create_safety_features():
        main_span_length = 360  # Match main span length
        
        # Median barrier - main span only
        median = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 4, 8)
        median.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, -2, 14)
        median_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "MedianBarrier")
        median_obj.Shape = median
        median_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.83, 0.83, 0.83)  # LightGray
        
        # Guardrails - main span
        guardrail_parts = []
        for y_pos in [-32, 32]:
            # Bottom rail
            bottom_rail = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 2, 2)
            bottom_rail.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, y_pos - 1, 14)
            guardrail_parts.append(bottom_rail)
            
            # Top rail
            top_rail = Part.makeBox(main_span_length, 2, 2)
            top_rail.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-180, y_pos - 1, 22)
            guardrail_parts.append(top_rail)
            
            # Posts
            for x_pos in range(-175, 176, 15):
                post = Part.makeBox(1, 2, 10)
                post.Placement.Base = App.Vector(x_pos - 0.5, y_pos - 1, 14)
                guardrail_parts.append(post)
        
        # Combine guardrail parts
        guardrails = guardrail_parts[0]
        for part in guardrail_parts[1:]:
            guardrails = guardrails.fuse(part)
        
        guardrail_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Guardrails")
        guardrail_obj.Shape = guardrails
    # Guardrails for approach spans - connected system
    def create_approach_guardrails():
        """Create continuous guardrails across all bridge sections"""
        approach_guardrail_parts = []
        
        # Left approach guardrails - seamlessly connected
        for y_pos in [-32, 32]:  # Match main span guardrail positions
            # Bottom rail
            left_bottom = Part.makeBox(120, 2, 2)  # Match main guardrail dimensions
            left_bottom.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-300, y_pos - 1, 14)
            approach_guardrail_parts.append(left_bottom)
            
            # Top rail  
            left_top = Part.makeBox(120, 2, 2)
            left_top.Placement.Base = App.Vector(-300, y_pos - 1, 22)
            approach_guardrail_parts.append(left_top)
            
            # Right approach guardrails - seamlessly connected
            right_bottom = Part.makeBox(120, 2, 2)
            right_bottom.Placement.Base = App.Vector(180, y_pos - 1, 14)
            approach_guardrail_parts.append(right_bottom)
            
            right_top = Part.makeBox(120, 2, 2)
            right_top.Placement.Base = App.Vector(180, y_pos - 1, 22)
            approach_guardrail_parts.append(right_top)

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import Draft
import math

def create_arch_bridge():
    # Create new document
    doc = App.newDocument("ArchBridge")
    
    # Water and riverbed

    water_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Water")
    water_obj.Shape = water
    water_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.27, 0.51, 0.71)  # Steel Blue
    water_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 30
    
    riverbed = Part.makeBox(600, 180, 10, App.Vector(-300, -90, -60))
    riverbed_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Riverbed")
    riverbed_obj.Shape = riverbed
    riverbed_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.63, 0.32, 0.18)  # Sienna
    
    # Shore embankments
    for i, x in enumerate([-280, 280]):
        # Create hull-like shape for embankment
        bottom = Part.makeBox(60, 180, 10, App.Vector(x-30, -90, -60))
        top = Part.makeBox(40, 150, 10, App.Vector(x-20, -75, -50))
        
        # Create transition
        embankment = bottom.fuse(top)
        embankment_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Embankment_{i}")
        embankment_obj.Shape = embankment
        embankment_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.82, 0.71, 0.55)  # Tan
    
    # Main arch structure - create parametric arch using cylinders
    arch_shapes = []
    for y in [-35, 35]:
        arch_segments = []
        # Generate arch curve points and create cylinders between them
        for t in range(-250, 240, 10):  # Stop at 240 to avoid index issues
            x1 = t
            z1 = -40 + 50 * (1 - (t/250.0)**2)
            x2 = t + 10
            z2 = -40 + 50 * (1 - ((t+10)/250.0)**2)
            
            start_point = App.Vector(x1, y, z1)
            end_point = App.Vector(x2, y, z2)
            
            # Calculate segment length and direction
            direction = end_point.sub(start_point)
            length = direction.Length
            
            if length > 0:
                # Create cylinder segment
                cylinder = Part.makeCylinder(6, length, start_point, direction.normalize())
                arch_segments.append(cylinder)
        
        # Combine all segments for this arch
        if arch_segments:
            arch_side = arch_segments[0]
            for segment in arch_segments[1:]:
                arch_side = arch_side.fuse(segment)
            arch_shapes.append(arch_side)
    
    # Combine arch shapes
    if arch_shapes:
        main_arch = arch_shapes[0]
        for shape in arch_shapes[1:]:
            main_arch = main_arch.fuse(shape)

        arch_obj.Shape = main_arch
        arch_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.41, 0.41, 0.41)  # DimGray

    bracing_shapes = []
    for x in range(-240, 241, 40):
        # Calculate height based on arch equation
        z = -40 + 50 * (1 - (x/250.0)**2)
        
        # Vertical brace

        bracing_shapes.append(vertical_brace)
        
        # X-bracing
        if x < 240:  # Skip last segment
            next_z = -40 + 50 * (1 - ((x+40)/250.0)**2)
            
            # Create X-brace elements using cylinders
            for i in [-1, 1]:
                start_point = App.Vector(x, 35*i, z)
                end_point = App.Vector(x+40, -35*i, next_z)
                
                # Calculate direction and length
                direction = end_point.sub(start_point)
                length = direction.Length
                
                if length > 0:
                    x_brace = Part.makeCylinder(2, length, start_point, direction.normalize())
                    bracing_shapes.append(x_brace)
    
    # Combine all bracing
    if bracing_shapes:
        bracing = bracing_shapes[0]

        bracing_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.44, 0.50, 0.56)  # SlateGray

    for x in range(-260, 261, 30):

        for y in [-35, 35]:

            z = -40 + 50 * (1 - (x/250.0)**2)
            
            # Create cylindrical support

    if support_shapes:

    road_obj.Shape = road_surface
    road_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.19, 0.19, 0.19)  # Dark road color
    
    # Railings
    railing_shapes = []
    for y in [-40, 40]:
        # Bottom rail
        bottom_rail = Part.makeBox(550, 2, 2, App.Vector(-275, y-1, 19))
        railing_shapes.append(bottom_rail)
        
        # Top rail
        top_rail = Part.makeBox(550, 2, 2, App.Vector(-275, y-1, 29))
        railing_shapes.append(top_rail)
        
        # Posts
        for x in range(-270, 271, 10):
            post = Part.makeBox(1, 1, 10, App.Vector(x-0.5, y-0.5, 20))
            railing_shapes.append(post)
    
    if railing_shapes:
        railings = railing_shapes[0]
        for shape in railing_shapes[1:]:
            railings = railings.fuse(shape)
        
        railings_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Railings")
        railings_obj.Shape = railings
        railings_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.75, 0.75, 0.75)  # Silver
    
    # Decorative elements on side supports
    decorative_shapes = []
    for x in range(-240, 241, 80):
        for y in [-35, 35]:
            # Base cylinder
            base_cyl = Part.makeCylinder(5, 20, App.Vector(x, y, -6))
            decorative_shapes.append(base_cyl)
            
            # Top decorative element

[  """
Fixed Realistic Twin-Tower Cable-Stayed Bridge Design
FreeCAD Python API Implementation

Key Fixes:
- Corrected span-to-height ratio (1:5 to 1:8)
- Eliminated cyclic dependencies
- Simplified geometry while maintaining realism
- Fixed structural calculations
- Optimized cable arrangement
"""

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import Draft
import math

def create_realistic_cable_bridge():
    # Create new document
    doc = App.newDocument("CableStayedBridge")
    
    # Bridge parameters (corrected realistic proportions)
    total_span = 600.0  # Total bridge length (meters)
    main_span = 350.0   # Main span between towers
    side_span = 125.0   # Side spans
    tower_height = 70.0 # Tower height above deck (corrected ratio)
    deck_width = 28.0   # Bridge deck width
    deck_thickness = 3.0 # Box girder depth
    tower_width = 6.0   # Tower width at base
    tower_depth = 4.0   # Tower depth
    
    all_objects = []  # Store all objects to avoid cyclic dependencies
    
    # Realistic foundations and abutments
    def create_foundations():
        foundations = []
        
        # Main tower foundations - deep caisson style
        for x_pos in [-main_span/2, main_span/2]:
            # Large foundation pad (like real bridges)
            foundation_pad = Part.makeBox(40, 35, 25)
            foundation_pad.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 20, -17.5, -35))
            
            # Pier extending above water level
            pier_main = Part.makeCylinder(12, 20)
            pier_main.translate(App.Vector(x_pos, 0, -15))
            
            # Pier cap with beveled edges
            pier_cap = Part.makeBox(18, 16, 8)
            pier_cap.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 9, -8, 5))
            
            # Bevel the pier cap edges
            bevel = Part.makeCylinder(2, 8)
            for corner_x in [-7, 7]:
                for corner_y in [-6, 6]:
                    bevel_copy = bevel.copy()
                    bevel_copy.translate(App.Vector(x_pos + corner_x, corner_y, 5))
                    pier_cap = pier_cap.fuse(bevel_copy)
            
            # Combine foundation elements
            foundation = foundation_pad.fuse(pier_main).fuse(pier_cap)
            foundations.append(foundation)
        
        # End abutments - realistic approach structures
        for x_pos in [-total_span/2, total_span/2]:
            # Main abutment wall
            abutment_wall = Part.makeBox(15, deck_width + 8, 25)
            abutment_wall.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 7.5, -deck_width/2 - 4, -10))
            
            # Wing walls for soil retention
            for wing_side in [-1, 1]:
                wing_y = wing_side * (deck_width/2 + 4)
                wing_wall = Part.makeBox(8, 4, 20)
                wing_wall.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 4, wing_y, -5))
                abutment_wall = abutment_wall.fuse(wing_wall)
            
            # Approach slab
            approach_slab = Part.makeBox(20, deck_width, 1)
            if x_pos < 0:  # Left approach
                approach_slab.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 20, -deck_width/2, 9.5))
            else:  # Right approach
                approach_slab.translate(App.Vector(x_pos, -deck_width/2, 9.5))
            
            abutment_complete = abutment_wall.fuse(approach_slab)
            foundations.append(abutment_complete)
            
        return foundations
    
    # Reinforced tower base design
    def create_tower(x_position):
        # Realistic tower with proper base
        base_width = tower_width * 1.8  # Wider base for stability
        top_width = tower_width * 0.5
        
        # Foundation connection block
        base_block = Part.makeBox(base_width + 4, tower_depth + 4, 12)
        base_block.translate(App.Vector(-base_width/2 - 2, -tower_depth/2 - 2, 5))
        
        # Tower base - wider for stability
        tower_base = Part.makeBox(base_width, tower_depth, 15)
        tower_base.translate(App.Vector(-base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 17))
        
        # Transition section
        mid_width = tower_width * 1.2
        transition_points_base = [
            App.Vector(-base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 32),
            App.Vector(base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 32),
            App.Vector(base_width/2, tower_depth/2, 32),
            App.Vector(-base_width/2, tower_depth/2, 32)
        ]
        
        transition_points_mid = [
            App.Vector(-mid_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(mid_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(mid_width/2, tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(-mid_width/2, tower_depth/2, 45)
        ]
        
        # Main tower section
        tower_points_mid = [
            App.Vector(-mid_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(mid_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(mid_width/2, tower_depth/2, 45),
            App.Vector(-mid_width/2, tower_depth/2, 45)
        ]
        
        tower_points_top = [
            App.Vector(-top_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 10 + tower_height),
            App.Vector(top_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 10 + tower_height),
            App.Vector(top_width/2, tower_depth/2, 10 + tower_height),
            App.Vector(-top_width/2, tower_depth/2, 10 + tower_height)
        ]
        
        # Create faces and loft
        base_wire = Part.makePolygon(transition_points_base + [transition_points_base[0]])
        mid_wire = Part.makePolygon(transition_points_mid + [transition_points_mid[0]])
        top_wire = Part.makePolygon(tower_points_top + [tower_points_top[0]])
        
        base_face = Part.Face(base_wire)
        mid_face = Part.Face(mid_wire)
        top_face = Part.Face(top_wire)
        
        tower_main = Part.makeLoft([base_face, mid_face, top_face], True)
        
        # Combine all tower parts
        tower = base_block.fuse(tower_base).fuse(tower_main)
        
        # Reinforced cable attachment brackets
        bracket_levels = [25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 75, 85]
        for z in bracket_levels:
            # Stronger attachment points
            bracket = Part.makeBox(3, tower_depth + 1, 2)
            bracket.translate(App.Vector(-1.5, -tower_depth/2 - 0.5, z))
            tower = tower.fuse(bracket)
        
        # Position tower
        tower.translate(App.Vector(x_position, 0, 0))
        return tower
    
    # Professional multi-cell box girder deck
    def create_bridge_deck():
        # Create realistic multi-cell box girder in sections
        deck_segments = []
        segment_length = 25.0  # Smaller segments for better geometry
        num_segments = int(total_span / segment_length)
        
        for i in range(num_segments):
            x_start = -total_span/2 + i * segment_length
            
            # Main box girder outer shell
            outer_shell = Part.makeBox(segment_length, deck_width, deck_thickness)
            
            # Create multiple internal cells (like real bridges)
            cell_width = (deck_width - 1.5) / 3  # 3 cells across width
            
            for cell_i in range(3):
                cell_y_start = 0.5 + cell_i * cell_width
                
                # Internal cavity
                cavity = Part.makeBox(segment_length - 0.6, cell_width - 0.3, deck_thickness - 0.6)
                cavity.translate(App.Vector(0.3, cell_y_start, 0.3))
                outer_shell = outer_shell.cut(cavity)
            
            # Longitudinal webs (every 5m)
            for web_x in [5, 10, 15, 20]:
                if web_x < segment_length:

prompt: Create a realistic twin-tower cable-stayed bridge, ensuring correct engineering proportions, aerodynamic towers, and proper cable attachments to a box-girder deck.
script:
[  """
Realistic Twin-Tower Cable-Stayed Bridge Design - FIXED VERSION
FreeCAD Python API Implementation

Engineering Considerations:
- Proper tower height to span ratio (1:5 to 1:8) - FIXED
- Realistic cable stay angles (20-65 degrees optimal)
- Proper deck thickness and box girder design
- Foundation piers with realistic proportions
- Wind resistance and aerodynamic considerations
- Fixed cyclic dependencies in document groups
- Corrected cable attachment points to deck edges
"""

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import Draft
import math

def create_realistic_cable_bridge():
    # Create new document
    doc = App.newDocument("CableStayedBridge")
    
    # Bridge parameters (realistic proportions) - CORRECTED
    total_span = 800.0  # Total bridge length (meters)
    main_span = 400.0   # Main span between towers
    side_span = 200.0   # Side spans
    tower_height = 100.0  # Tower height above deck (REDUCED for proper ratio)
    deck_width = 30.0   # Bridge deck width
    deck_thickness = 3.5  # Box girder depth
    tower_width = 8.0   # Tower width at base
    tower_depth = 6.0   # Tower depth
    
    # Store created objects for proper grouping
    created_objects = {
        'foundations': [],
        'towers': [],
        'deck': [],
        'cables': [],
        'roadway': [],
        'lighting': [],
        'environment': []
    }
    
    # Foundation and piers
    def create_foundations():
        foundations = []
        # Main tower foundations
        for x_pos in [-main_span/2, main_span/2]:
            # Foundation base (underwater)
            foundation_base = Part.makeBox(25, 25, 15)
            foundation_base.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 12.5, -12.5, -25))
            
            # Pier (above water)
            pier = Part.makeBox(15, 15, 20)
            pier.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 7.5, -7.5, -10))
            
            # Combine foundation and pier
            foundation = foundation_base.fuse(pier)
            foundations.append(foundation)
            
        # Abutments at ends
        for x_pos in [-total_span/2, total_span/2]:
            abutment = Part.makeBox(20, 40, 25)
            abutment.translate(App.Vector(x_pos - 10, -20, -15))
            foundations.append(abutment)
            
        return foundations
    
    # Tower design with realistic proportions
    def create_tower(x_position):
        # Tower base (wider at bottom)
        base_width = tower_width
        top_width = tower_width * 0.7
        
        # Create tower using loft between rectangles
        base_rect = Part.makePolygon([
            App.Vector(-base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 0),
            App.Vector(base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 0),
            App.Vector(base_width/2, tower_depth/2, 0),
            App.Vector(-base_width/2, tower_depth/2, 0),
            App.Vector(-base_width/2, -tower_depth/2, 0)
        ])
        
        top_rect = Part.makePolygon([
            App.Vector(-top_width/2, -tower_depth/2, tower_height),
            App.Vector(top_width/2, -tower_depth/2, tower_height),
            App.Vector(top_width/2, tower_depth/2, tower_height),
            App.Vector(-top_width/2, tower_depth/2, tower_height),
            App.Vector(-top_width/2, -tower_depth/2, tower_height)
        ])
        
        # Create faces and loft
        base_face = Part.Face(base_rect)
        top_face = Part.Face(top_rect)
        tower_solid = Part.makeLoft([base_face, top_face], True)
        
        # Add architectural details - hollow sections for wind resistance
        for z in range(20, int(tower_height), 25):
            cutout = Part.makeBox(top_width * 0.6, tower_depth * 0.4, 10)
            cutout.translate(App.Vector(-top_width * 0.3, -tower_depth * 0.2, z))
            tower_solid = tower_solid.cut(cutout)
        
        # Position tower
        tower_solid.translate(App.Vector(x_position, 0, 10))
        return tower_solid
    
    # Bridge deck with realistic box girder
    def create_bridge_deck():
        # Main deck structure - box girder design
        deck_segments = []
        
        # Create deck in segments for realistic construction
        segment_length = 40.0
        num_segments = int(total_span / segment_length)
        
        for i in range(num_segments):
            x_start = -total_span/2 + i * segment_length
            
            # Outer shell
            outer_box = Part.makeBox(segment_length, deck_width, deck_thickness)
            
            # Inner hollow (for weight reduction)
            inner_box = Part.makeBox(segment_length - 2, deck_width - 4, deck_thickness - 1)
            inner_box.translate(App.Vector(1, 2, 0.5))
            
            # Create hollow box girder
            segment = outer_box.cut(inner_box)
            
            # Add internal stiffeners every 4 meters
            for stiff_x in range(4, int(segment_length), 4):
                stiffener = Part.makeBox(0.3, deck_width - 4, deck_thickness - 1)
                stiffener.translate(App.Vector(stiff_x, 2, 0.5))
                segment = segment.fuse(stiffener)
            
            segment.translate(App.Vector(x_start, -deck_width/2, 10))
            deck_segments.append(segment)
        
        # Fuse all segments
        deck = deck_segments[0]
        for segment in deck_segments[1:]:
            deck = deck.fuse(segment)
            
        return deck
    
    # Stay cables with proper angles and CORRECTED attachment points
    def create_stay_cables():
        cables = []
        
        # Cable parameters
        cable_radius = 0.15  # 30cm diameter cable bundle
        min_angle = math.radians(25)  # Minimum angle from vertical
        max_angle = math.radians(65)  # Maximum angle from vertical
        
        for tower_x in [-main_span/2, main_span/2]:
            # Multiple cable levels on each tower
            cable_levels = [25, 40, 55, 70, 85]  # Adjusted for shorter tower
            
            for level in cable_levels:
                level_z = 10 + level  # Tower base is at z=10
                
                # FIXED: Cables attach to deck EDGES, not through roadway
                for side in [-1, 1]:  # Both sides of bridge
                    # Attach cables to the EDGE of the deck structure
                    deck_y = side * (deck_width/2 - 1)  # Just inside the deck edge
                    
                    # Multiple cables per level - fan pattern
                    if tower_x < 0:  # Left tower
                        cable_spacings = [-180, -120, -80, -40, 20, 60, 100, 140]
                    else:  # Right tower  
                        cable_spacings = [-140, -100, -60, -20, 40, 80, 120, 180]
                    
                    for deck_x_offset in cable_spacings:
                        deck_x = tower_x + deck_x_offset
                        
                        # Check if within bridge span and angle constraints
                        if abs(deck_x) < total_span/2 - 20:
                            # Calculate cable geometry
                            dx = deck_x - tower_x
                            dz = level_z - 13.5  # Deck top surface is at z=13.5
                            cable_length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz + (deck_y*deck_y))
                            angle = math.atan2(abs(dx), dz)
                            
                            # Only create cable if angle is within optimal range
                            if min_angle <= angle <= max_angle:
                                # Tower attachment point - at side of tower
                                tower_attach = App.Vector(tower_x + side * tower_width/3, 
                                                        side * tower_depth/4, level_z)
                                
                                # Deck attachment point - at deck edge
                                deck_attach = App.Vector(deck_x, deck_y, 13.5)
                                
                                # Create cable as cylinder
                                cable_direction = deck_attach.sub(tower_attach)
                                cable_length = cable_direction.Length
                                
                                cable = Part.makeCylinder(cable_radius, cable_length)
                                
                                # Calculate rotation angles
                                # Rotate to align with cable direction
                                if cable_length > 0:
                                    # Normalize direction vector
                                    cable_direction.normalize()
                                    
                                    # Create rotation to align cylinder axis with cable direction
                                    # Default cylinder is along Z-axis
                                    z_axis = App.Vector(0, 0, 1)
                                    
                                    # Calculate rotation axis and angle
                                    rotation_axis = z_axis.cross(cable_direction)
                                    if rotation_axis.Length > 1e-6:
                                        rotation_axis.normalize()
                                        rotation_angle = math.acos(max(-1, min(1, z_axis.dot(cable_direction))))
                                        cable.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation_axis, math.degrees(rotation_angle))
                                    
                                    # Position cable at tower attachment point
                                    cable.translate(tower_attach)
                                    cables.append(cable)
        
        return cables
    
    # Roadway and safety features
    def create_roadway_features():

            edge_line.translate(App.Vector(-total_span/2 + 20, y_offset, 13.6))
            features.append(edge_line)
        
        # Barrier/guardrails - POSITIONED CORRECTLY
        for side in [-1, 1]:
            rail_y = side * (deck_width/2 - 0.5)  # Right at deck edge
            
            # Posts every 8 meters
            for x in range(-int(total_span/2) + 20, int(total_span/2) - 20, 8):
                post = Part.makeCylinder(0.15, 1.2)
                post.translate(App.Vector(x, rail_y, 13.5))
                features.append(post)
            
            # Top rail
            top_rail = Part.makeCylinder(0.1, total_span - 40)
            top_rail.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 1, 0), 90)
            top_rail.translate(App.Vector(-total_span/2 + 20, rail_y, 14.5))
            features.append(top_rail)
        
        return features
    
    # Lighting system
    def create_lighting():
        lights = []
        
        # Street lighting every 25 meters
        for x in range(-int(total_span/2) + 25, int(total_span/2), 25):
            for side in [-1, 1]:
                light_y = side * (deck_width/2 - 3)
                
                # Light pole
                pole = Part.makeCylinder(0.2, 8)
                pole.translate(App.Vector(x, light_y, 13.5))
                lights.append(pole)
                
                # Light fixture
                fixture = Part.makeSphere(0.8)
                fixture.translate(App.Vector(x, light_y, 21.5))
                lights.append(fixture)
        
        # Tower lighting (aviation safety)
        for tower_x in [-main_span/2, main_span/2]:
            # Top strobe light
            strobe = Part.makeSphere(1.5)
            strobe.translate(App.Vector(tower_x, 0, 10 + tower_height + 5))
            lights.append(strobe)
            
            # Tower accent lighting
            for z_level in [30, 50, 70, 90]:  # Adjusted for shorter tower
                for side in [-1, 1]:
                    accent_light = Part.makeSphere(0.5)
                    accent_light.translate(App.Vector(tower_x, side * tower_depth/2, 10 + z_level))
                    lights.append(accent_light)
        
        return lights
    
    # Environmental elements
    def create_environment():
        env_elements = []
        
        # Water body (river/bay)
        water = Part.makeBox(total_span + 200, 400, 30)
        water.translate(App.Vector(-total_span/2 - 100, -200, -40))
        env_elements.append(water)
        
        # Riverbed
        riverbed = Part.makeBox(total_span + 300, 500, 20)
        riverbed.translate(App.Vector(-total_span/2 - 150, -250, -60))
        env_elements.append(riverbed)
        
        return env_elements
    
    # Create all bridge components
    print("Creating foundations...")
    foundations = create_foundations()
    
    print("Creating towers...")
    tower_left = create_tower(-main_span/2)
    tower_right = create_tower(main_span/2)
    
    print("Creating bridge deck...")
    deck = create_bridge_deck()
    
    print("Creating stay cables...")
    cables = create_stay_cables()
    
    print("Creating roadway features...")
    roadway_features = create_roadway_features()
    
    print("Creating lighting system...")
    lighting = create_lighting()
    
    print("Creating environment...")
    environment = create_environment()
    
    # Add all objects to document with proper names and colors
    # FIXED: Create objects first, then group them to avoid cyclic dependencies
    
    # Environment
    water_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Water")
    water_obj.Shape = environment[0]
    water_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.0, 0.4, 0.8, 0.7)  # Blue water
    created_objects['environment'].append(water_obj)
    
    riverbed_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Riverbed")
    riverbed_obj.Shape = environment[1]
    riverbed_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.4, 0.3, 0.2)  # Brown riverbed
    created_objects['environment'].append(riverbed_obj)
    
    # Foundations
    for i, foundation in enumerate(foundations):
        found_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Foundation_{i}")
        found_obj.Shape = foundation
        found_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.6, 0.6, 0.6)  # Concrete gray
        created_objects['foundations'].append(found_obj)
    
    # Towers
    tower_left_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Tower_Left")
    tower_left_obj.Shape = tower_left
    tower_left_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)  # Light gray concrete
    created_objects['towers'].append(tower_left_obj)
    
    tower_right_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Tower_Right")
    tower_right_obj.Shape = tower_right
    tower_right_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
    created_objects['towers'].append(tower_right_obj)
    
    # Bridge deck
    deck_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Bridge_Deck")
    deck_obj.Shape = deck
    deck_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.3, 0.3, 0.3)  # Dark gray steel
    created_objects['deck'].append(deck_obj)
    
    # Stay cables
    for i, cable in enumerate(cables):
        cable_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Cable_{i:03d}")
        cable_obj.Shape = cable
        cable_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.9, 0.9, 0.9)  # White/light gray cables
        cable_obj.ViewObject.LineWidth = 2.0
        created_objects['cables'].append(cable_obj)
    
    # Roadway features
    for i, feature in enumerate(roadway_features):
        if i == 0:  # Asphalt
            road_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Asphalt")
            road_obj.Shape = feature
            road_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.1, 0.1, 0.1)  # Black asphalt
            created_objects['roadway'].append(road_obj)
        elif i <= 3:  # Lane markings
            marking_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Lane_Marking_{i}")
            marking_obj.Shape = feature
            marking_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (1.0, 1.0, 0.0)  # Yellow markings
            created_objects['roadway'].append(marking_obj)
        else:  # Guardrails and posts
            rail_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Guardrail_{i}")
            rail_obj.Shape = feature
            rail_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.7, 0.7, 0.7)  # Galvanized steel
            created_objects['roadway'].append(rail_obj)
    
    # Lighting
    for i, light in enumerate(lighting):
        light_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Light_{i:03d}")
        light_obj.Shape = light
        if i % 2 == 1:  # Light fixtures (every other object)
            light_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (1.0, 1.0, 0.8)  # Warm white light
        elif i < len(lighting) - 10:  # Regular poles
            light_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.2, 0.2, 0.2)  # Dark poles
        else:  # Aviation lights
            light_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)  # Red aviation lights
        created_objects['lighting'].append(light_obj)
    
    # Recompute before creating groups
    doc.recompute()
    
    # FIXED: Create groups AFTER all objects are created and computed
    try:
        foundation_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Foundations")
        foundation_group.Group = created_objects['foundations']
        
        structure_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Main_Structure")
        structure_group.Group = created_objects['towers'] + created_objects['deck']
        
        cable_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Stay_Cables")
        cable_group.Group = created_objects['cables']
        
        roadway_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Roadway")
        roadway_group.Group = created_objects['roadway']
        
        lighting_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Lighting")
        lighting_group.Group = created_objects['lighting']
        
        environment_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "Environment")
        environment_group.Group = created_objects['environment']
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Note: Could not create groups due to: {e}")
        print("All objects created successfully, grouping skipped.")
    
    # Final recompute
    doc.recompute()
    
    # Set view to isometric
    try:
        import FreeCADGui as Gui
        Gui.activeDocument().activeView().viewIsometric()
        Gui.SendMsgToActiveView("ViewFit")
    except:

    print("Bridge design completed!")
    print(f"Bridge specifications:")

    print(f"- Main span: {main_span}m")
    print(f"- Tower height: {tower_height}m above deck")
    print(f"- Deck width: {deck_width}m")
    print(f"- Number of stay cables: {len(cables)}")
    print(f"- Design load capacity: ~50,000 vehicles/day")
    
    return doc

# Engineering validation functions
def validate_cable_angles(tower_positions, cable_attachments):
    """Validate that all cable angles are within safe engineering limits"""
    valid_cables = 0
    total_cables = 0
    
    for tower_x, tower_z in tower_positions:
        for deck_x, deck_z in cable_attachments:
            total_cables += 1
            dx = abs(deck_x - tower_x)
            dz = tower_z - deck_z
            angle = math.atan2(dx, dz)
            
            # Check if angle is within 25-65 degree range
            if math.radians(25) <= angle <= math.radians(65):
                valid_cables += 1
    
    return valid_cables / total_cables if total_cables > 0 else 0

def calculate_structural_loads():

    # Live load (traffic)

    # Wind load (simplified) - CORRECTED for new tower height

    print(f"\nStructural Analysis:")

    print(f"- Design live load: {total_live_load/1000:.1f} kN")
    print(f"- Tower wind load: {wind_load/1000:.1f} kN")
    
    return deck_weight, total_live_load, wind_load

# Run the bridge creation
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Global parameters for validation - CORRECTED
    total_span = 800.0

    tower_height = 100.0  # FIXED: Reduced for proper engineering ratio

    deck_thickness = 3.5
    tower_width = 8.0
    tower_depth = 6.0
    
    # Create the bridge
    bridge_doc = create_realistic_cable_bridge()
    
    # Perform engineering validation
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("ENGINEERING VALIDATION - FIXED")
    print("="*50)
    
    # Validate proportions - CORRECTED
    span_to_height_ratio = main_span / tower_height
    print(f"Span to tower height ratio: {span_to_height_ratio:.2f}")

    calculate_structural_loads()
    
    # Validate cable angles

script:
[#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Enhanced Parametric Arch Bridge Design for FreeCAD
Fixed structural design with proper engineering and no vacant spaces
Realistic proportions and complete structural connectivity
"""

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import Draft
import math

# Create new document
doc = App.newDocument("EnhancedArchBridge")

# =============================================================================
# ENHANCED BRIDGE PARAMETERS (Real-world engineering optimized)
# =============================================================================

class EnhancedBridgeParameters:
    """Optimized parametric bridge design parameters"""
    
    # Main bridge dimensions (reduced for better proportions)
    TOTAL_LENGTH = 320000   # 320m total bridge length
    DECK_WIDTH = 32000      # 32m deck width (4-lane highway + walkways)
    ROADWAY_WIDTH = 28000   # 28m clear roadway width (4 lanes)
    WALKWAY_WIDTH = 2000    # 2m walkways on each side
    
    # Arch parameters (optimized ratios)
    ARCH_SPAN = 280000      # 280m main arch span
    ARCH_RISE = 35000       # 35m arch rise (1:8 ratio - efficient)
    ARCH_THICKNESS = 3000   # 3m arch thickness
    ARCH_WIDTH = 6000       # 6m arch width
    ARCH_COUNT = 4          # 4 parallel arch ribs for stability
    
    # Deck parameters
    DECK_THICKNESS = 1500   # 1.5m deck thickness
    DECK_HEIGHT = 15000     # 15m deck height above water
    
    # Structural elements
    PIER_WIDTH = 6000       # 6m pier width
    PIER_LENGTH = 8000      # 8m pier length
    ABUTMENT_WIDTH = 20000  # 20m abutment width
    ABUTMENT_HEIGHT = 35000 # 35m abutment height
    
    # Spandrel walls and fill
    SPANDREL_THICKNESS = 1000 # 1m spandrel wall thickness
    FILL_HEIGHT = 8000        # 8m fill height above arch crown
    
    # Vertical supports (eliminates vacant space)
    VERTICAL_SPACING = 20000    # 20m vertical support spacing
    VERTICAL_DIAMETER = 1200    # 1.2m diameter columns
    
    # Cross bracing system
    CROSS_BRACE_SPACING = 15000 # 15m cross brace spacing
    BRACE_DIAMETER = 800        # 800mm brace diameter
    
    # Safety features
    RAILING_HEIGHT = 1400   # 1.4m railing height
    BARRIER_HEIGHT = 800    # 800mm concrete barrier height
    CLEARANCE_HEIGHT = 8000 # 8m navigation clearance
    
    # Foundation system
    PILE_DIAMETER = 1500      # 1.5m pile diameter
    PILE_DEPTH = 25000        # 25m pile depth
    PILE_CAP_THICKNESS = 3000 # 3m pile cap thickness

def create_continuous_arch_system():
    """Create continuous arch system with multiple ribs"""
    
    print("Creating enhanced arch system...")
    arches = []
    
    try:
        # Calculate arch rib positions
        rib_spacing = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH / (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT + 1)
        rib_positions = []
        for i in range(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT):
            y_pos = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + (i + 1) * rib_spacing
            rib_positions.append(y_pos)
        
        # Create each arch rib using proper parabolic curve
        for rib_id, y_position in enumerate(rib_positions):
            # Create points for arch curve
            points = []
            segments = 50  # High resolution curve
            
            for i in range(segments + 1):
                t = i / segments
                x = (t - 0.5) * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
                
                # Parabolic arch equation: y = 4h(x/L)(1 - x/L)
                normalized_x = t
                z_crown = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT
                z = z_crown - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                    4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * normalized_x * (1 - normalized_x)
                
                points.append(App.Vector(x, y_position, z))
            
            # Create spline through points
            try:
                spline = Part.BSplineCurve()
                spline.interpolate(points)
                arch_wire = Part.Wire([spline.toShape()])
                
                # Create rectangular cross-section
                rect_face = Part.Face(Part.Wire([
                    Part.makeLine(
                        App.Vector(-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   -EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0),
                        App.Vector(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   -EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0)
                    ),
                    Part.makeLine(
                        App.Vector(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   -EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0),
                        App.Vector(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0)
                    ),
                    Part.makeLine(
                        App.Vector(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0),
                        App.Vector(-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0)
                    ),
                    Part.makeLine(
                        App.Vector(-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0),
                        App.Vector(-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2, 
                                   -EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2, 0)
                    )
                ]))
                
                # Sweep cross-section along arch curve
                arch_solid = rect_face.extrude(arch_wire)
                
                arch_obj = Part.show(arch_solid, f"ArchRib_{rib_id}")
                arch_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
                arches.append(arch_obj)
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Spline arch creation failed for rib {rib_id}, creating box arch: {e}")
                # Fallback: create segmented arch
                segments = 20
                arch_segments = []
                
                for i in range(segments):
                    t = i / segments
                    x = (t - 0.5) * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
                    normalized_x = t
                    z_crown = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT
                    z = z_crown - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                        4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * normalized_x * (1 - normalized_x)
                    
                    segment = Part.makeBox(
                        EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN / segments * 1.1,
                        EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH,
                        EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS,
                        App.Vector(x - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN / segments * 0.55,
                                   y_position - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2,
                                   z - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS/2)
                    )
                    arch_segments.append(segment)
                
                # Fuse segments
                if arch_segments:
                    arch_rib = arch_segments[0]
                    for segment in arch_segments[1:]:
                        try:
                            arch_rib = arch_rib.fuse(segment)
                        except:
                            pass
                    
                    arch_obj = Part.show(arch_rib, f"ArchRib_{rib_id}")
                    arch_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
                    arches.append(arch_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Critical error in arch creation: {e}")
        # Create basic arch system as last resort
        for i in range(4):
            y_pos = -15000 + i * 10000
            simple_arch = Part.makeBox(
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN,
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH,
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_THICKNESS,
                App.Vector(-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2,
                           y_pos - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH/2,
                           EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - 20000)
            )
            arch_obj = Part.show(simple_arch, f"BasicArch_{i}")
            arch_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
            arches.append(arch_obj)
    
    return arches

def create_spandrel_walls():
    """Create spandrel walls to fill space between arches and deck"""
    
    print("Creating spandrel walls...")
    spandrels = []
    
    try:
        # Calculate spandrel wall positions between arch ribs
        rib_spacing = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH / (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT + 1)
        
        for i in range(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT + 1):
            if i == 0:
                # Wall from edge to first rib
                y_start = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2
                y_end = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + rib_spacing - rib_spacing/4
            elif i == EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT:
                # Wall from last rib to edge
                y_start = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + i * rib_spacing + rib_spacing/4
                y_end = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2
            else:
                # Walls between ribs
                y_start = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + i * rib_spacing + rib_spacing/4
                y_end = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + (i + 1) * rib_spacing - rib_spacing/4
            
            wall_width = y_end - y_start
            if wall_width > 1000:  # Only create if meaningful width
                
                # Create tapered spandrel wall following arch curve
                wall_segments = []
                segments = 20
                
                for j in range(segments):
                    t = j / segments
                    x = (t - 0.5) * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
                    
                    # Height varies from arch crown to deck level
                    normalized_x = t
                    arch_crown_z = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT - \
                                   EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                                   4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * normalized_x * (1 - normalized_x)
                    deck_z = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT
                    wall_height = deck_z - arch_crown_z + 1000  # Overlap with deck
                    
                    if wall_height > 500:  # Only create if sufficient height
                        segment = Part.makeBox(
                            EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN / segments * 1.1,
                            wall_width,
                            wall_height,
                            App.Vector(x - EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN / segments * 0.55,
                                       y_start,
                                       arch_crown_z)
                        )
                        wall_segments.append(segment)
                
                # Fuse segments to create continuous wall
                if wall_segments:
                    spandrel_wall = wall_segments[0]
                    for segment in wall_segments[1:]:
                        try:
                            spandrel_wall = spandrel_wall.fuse(segment)
                        except:
                            pass
                    
                    wall_obj = Part.show(spandrel_wall, f"SpandrelWall_{i}")
                    wall_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)
                    spandrels.append(wall_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating spandrel walls: {e}")
    
    return spandrels

def create_arch_fill_system():
    """Create structural fill above arches to eliminate vacant space"""
    
    print("Creating arch fill system...")
    fill_elements = []
    
    try:
        # Create granular fill above arch crown
        fill_segments = []
        segments = 15
        
        for i in range(segments):
            t = i / segments
            x_start = (t - 0.5) * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
            x_end = ((i + 1) / segments - 0.5) * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
            segment_width = x_end - x_start
            
            # Calculate fill height at this location
            normalized_x = t
            arch_crown_z = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT - \
                           EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                           4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * normalized_x * (1 - normalized_x)
            
            fill_height = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - arch_crown_z - 500  # 500mm clearance
            
            if fill_height > 1000:  # Only create if meaningful height
                fill_segment = Part.makeBox(
                    segment_width * 1.1,  # Slight overlap
                    EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH - 4000,  # Leave edge clearance
                    fill_height,
                    App.Vector(x_start - segment_width * 0.05,
                               -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + 2000,
                               arch_crown_z + 500)
                )
                fill_segments.append(fill_segment)
        
        # Combine fill segments
        if fill_segments:
            arch_fill = fill_segments[0]
            for segment in fill_segments[1:]:
                try:
                    arch_fill = arch_fill.fuse(segment)
                except:
                    pass
            
            fill_obj = Part.show(arch_fill, "ArchFill")
            fill_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.6, 0.5, 0.4)  # Fill material color
            fill_elements.append(fill_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating arch fill: {e}")
    
    return fill_elements

def create_vertical_support_system():
    """Create vertical supports between arches and deck - eliminates vacant space"""
    
    print("Creating vertical support system...")
    supports = []
    
    try:
        # Create vertical supports at regular intervals
        support_positions = list(range(-120000, 140000, EnhancedBridgeParameters.VERTICAL_SPACING))
        
        for x_pos in support_positions:
            # Calculate arch height at this position
            t = (x_pos + EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2) / EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
            normalized_x = max(0, min(1, t))
            
            arch_crown_z = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT - \
                           EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                           4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * normalized_x * (1 - normalized_x)
            
            support_height = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - arch_crown_z - 1000
            
            if support_height > 2000:  # Only create if sufficient height needed
                # Create supports at quarter points across width
                for j in range(3):
                    y_pos = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/3 + j * EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/3
                    
                    # Tapered column (wider at base)
                    base_radius = EnhancedBridgeParameters.VERTICAL_DIAMETER/2 * 1.2
                    top_radius = EnhancedBridgeParameters.VERTICAL_DIAMETER/2
                    
                    # Create as cone for tapered effect
                    column = Part.makeCone(
                        base_radius, top_radius,
                        support_height,
                        App.Vector(x_pos, y_pos, arch_crown_z + 500)
                    )
                    
                    support_obj = Part.show(column, f"VerticalSupport_{x_pos}_{j}")
                    support_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.45, 0.45, 0.45)
                    supports.append(support_obj)
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating vertical supports: {e}")
    
    return supports

def create_cross_bracing_network():
    """Create comprehensive cross-bracing network"""
    
    print("Creating cross-bracing network...")
    braces = []
    
    try:
        # Longitudinal bracing along deck length
        brace_positions = list(range(-120000, 120000, EnhancedBridgeParameters.CROSS_BRACE_SPACING))
        
        for i in range(len(brace_positions) - 1):
            x_start = brace_positions[i]
            x_end = brace_positions[i + 1]
            brace_length = math.sqrt((x_end - x_start)**2)
            
            # Lower level bracing
            lower_brace = Part.makeCylinder(
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.BRACE_DIAMETER/2,
                brace_length,
                App.Vector(x_start, 0, EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - 8000),
                App.Vector(1, 0, 0)
            )
            
            brace_obj = Part.show(lower_brace, f"LongBrace_{i}")
            brace_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.3, 0.3, 0.4)
            braces.append(brace_obj)
            
            # Diagonal cross braces
            for side in [-1, 1]:
                y_center = side * EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/4
                
                # Create diagonal from one end to opposite side
                diagonal_length = math.sqrt(brace_length**2 + (EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2)**2)
                
                # Calculate rotation angles
                angle_z = math.atan2(side * EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2, brace_length)
                
                diagonal = Part.makeCylinder(
                    EnhancedBridgeParameters.BRACE_DIAMETER/3,
                    diagonal_length,
                    App.Vector(x_start, y_center, EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - 6000)
                )
                
                # Rotate to create X-pattern
                diagonal.rotate(App.Vector(x_start, y_center, EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - 6000),
                                App.Vector(0, 0, 1), math.degrees(angle_z))
                
                diag_obj = Part.show(diagonal, f"DiagBrace_{i}_{side}")
                diag_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.25, 0.25, 0.35)
                braces.append(diag_obj)
        
        # Transverse bracing across deck width
        for x_pos in brace_positions:
            trans_brace = Part.makeCylinder(
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.BRACE_DIAMETER/2,
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH,
                App.Vector(x_pos, -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2, 
                           EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - 4000),
                App.Vector(0, 1, 0)
            )
            
            trans_obj = Part.show(trans_brace, f"TransBrace_{x_pos}")
            trans_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.3, 0.3, 0.4)
            braces.append(trans_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating cross-bracing: {e}")
    
    return braces

def create_comprehensive_foundation():
    """Create comprehensive deep foundation system"""
    
    print("Creating comprehensive foundations...")
    foundations = []
    
    try:
        # Foundation locations under major structural points
        foundation_points = [
            # Under arch springings
            (-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2, -12000), (-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2, 12000),
            (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2, -12000), (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2, 12000),
            # Under arch quarter points
            (-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, -16000), (-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, 0), 
            (-EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, 16000),
            (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, -16000), (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, 0), 
            (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/4, 16000),
            # Under arch crown
            (0, -16000), (0, 0), (0, 16000)
        ]
        
        for i, (x_pos, y_pos) in enumerate(foundation_points):
            # Deep pile
            pile = Part.makeCylinder(
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_DIAMETER/2,
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_DEPTH,
                App.Vector(x_pos, y_pos, -45000 - EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_DEPTH)
            )
            
            # Pile cap with proper dimensions
            cap_size = EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_DIAMETER * 2
            pile_cap = Part.makeBox(
                cap_size, cap_size,
                EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_CAP_THICKNESS,
                App.Vector(x_pos - cap_size/2, y_pos - cap_size/2, -45000)
            )
            
            # Grade beam connecting pile caps
            if i > 0:
                prev_x, prev_y = foundation_points[i-1]
                beam_length = math.sqrt((x_pos - prev_x)**2 + (y_pos - prev_y)**2)
                
                if beam_length < 25000:  # Connect nearby foundations
                    grade_beam = Part.makeCylinder(
                        800,  # 1.6m diameter beam
                        beam_length,
                        App.Vector(prev_x, prev_y, -43000),
                        App.Vector((x_pos - prev_x)/beam_length, 
                                   (y_pos - prev_y)/beam_length, 0)
                    )
                    
                    beam_obj = Part.show(grade_beam, f"GradeBeam_{i}")
                    beam_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
                    foundations.append(beam_obj)
            
            # Combine pile and cap
            foundation_unit = Part.makeCompound([pile, pile_cap])
            foundation_obj = Part.show(foundation_unit, f"Foundation_{i}")
            foundation_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
            foundations.append(foundation_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating foundations: {e}")

def create_structural_connections():
    """Create all structural connections between elements"""
    
    print("Creating structural connections...")
    connections = []
    
    try:
        # Arch-to-deck connections (haunches)
        connection_positions = list(range(-120000, 140000, 30000))
        
        for x_pos in connection_positions:
            # Calculate arch height at this position
            t = (x_pos + EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN/2) / EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
            t = max(0, min(1, t))
            
            arch_z = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - EnhancedBridgeParameters.FILL_HEIGHT - \
                     EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE + \
                     4 * EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE * t * (1 - t)
            
            connection_height = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_HEIGHT - arch_z
            
            if connection_height > 1000:  # Only create meaningful connections
                # Create connection blocks at arch rib locations
                rib_spacing = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH / (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT + 1)
                
                for rib_id in range(EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT):
                    rib_y = -EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH/2 + (rib_id + 1) * rib_spacing
                    
                    connection_block = Part.makeBox(
                        3000,  # 3m connection length
                        EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH + 1000,  # Overlap arch
                        connection_height,
                        App.Vector(x_pos - 1500,
                                   rib_y - (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_WIDTH + 1000)/2,
                                   arch_z)
                    )
                    
                    conn_obj = Part.show(connection_block, f"Connection_{x_pos}_{rib_id}")
                    conn_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)
                    connections.append(conn_obj)
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error creating structural connections: {e}")
    
    return connections

def calculate_enhanced_loads():
    """Calculate comprehensive structural loads"""
    
    try:
        # More accurate load calculations
        deck_area = (EnhancedBridgeParameters.TOTAL_LENGTH * EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH) / 1000000
        
        # Dead loads
        concrete_volume = deck_area * EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_THICKNESS / 1000  # m³
        concrete_weight = concrete_volume * 24 * 9.81  # kN (24 kN/m³ concrete)
        
        # Live loads (highway loading)
        highway_load = deck_area * 12.0  # kN (12 kN/m² for highways)
        
        # Wind loads
        exposed_area = EnhancedBridgeParameters.TOTAL_LENGTH * 15000 / 1000000  # m² (exposed height)
        wind_load = exposed_area * 1.5  # kN (1.5 kN/m² wind pressure)
        
        # Seismic loads (estimated)
        total_mass = concrete_weight / 9.81  # tonnes
        seismic_load = total_mass * 0.2 * 9.81  # kN (0.2g seismic coefficient)
        
        loads = {
            "deck_dead_load_kN": round(concrete_weight, 1),
            "highway_live_load_kN": round(highway_load, 1),
            "wind_load_kN": round(wind_load, 1),
            "seismic_load_kN": round(seismic_load, 1),
            "total_load_kN": round(concrete_weight + highway_load + wind_load, 1),
            "load_per_arch_kN": round((concrete_weight + highway_load) / EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT, 1)
        }
        
        print("\n=== ENHANCED STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS ===")
        for load_type, value in loads.items():
            print(f"{load_type.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {value:,}")
        
        return loads
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error calculating loads: {e}")
        return {}

def run_enhanced_validation():
    """Run comprehensive design validation"""
    
    try:
        validation_results = []
        warnings = []
        
        # Structural ratios
        span_rise_ratio = EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN / EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_RISE
        if 6 <= span_rise_ratio <= 10:
            validation_results.append("✓ Arch span/rise ratio optimal (8:1)")
        else:
            warnings.append(f"⚠ Arch span/rise ratio {span_rise_ratio:.1f}:1 (recommend 6-10:1)")
        
        # Deck thickness check
        deck_span_ratio = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_THICKNESS / EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_SPAN
        if deck_span_ratio >= 1/200:
            validation_results.append("✓ Deck thickness adequate for span")
        else:
            warnings.append("⚠ Deck thickness may be insufficient for span")
        
        # Navigation clearance
        if EnhancedBridgeParameters.CLEARANCE_HEIGHT >= 8000:
            validation_results.append("✓ Navigation clearance meets standards")
        else:
            warnings.append("⚠ Navigation clearance below 8m minimum")
        
        # Arch rib spacing
        rib_spacing = EnhancedBridgeParameters.DECK_WIDTH / (EnhancedBridgeParameters.ARCH_COUNT + 1)
        if rib_spacing <= 12000:
            validation_results.append("✓ Arch rib spacing provides adequate support")
        else:
            warnings.append("⚠ Arch rib spacing may be too wide")
        
        # Foundation depth
        if EnhancedBridgeParameters.PILE_DEPTH >= 20000:
            validation_results.append("✓ Foundation depth adequate for major bridge")
        else:
            warnings.append("⚠ Foundation depth may be insufficient")
        
        print("\n=== DESIGN VALIDATION REPORT ===")
        print("PASSED CHECKS:")
        for result in validation_results:
            print(f"  {result}")
        
        if warnings:
            print("\nWARNINGS:")
            for warning in warnings:
