script:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import math

# ============================================================================
# PARAMETRIC VARIABLES - Adjust these for different configurations
# ============================================================================

# Building Overall Dimensions (in mm)
BUILDING_LENGTH = 40000  # Length of building (40m)
BUILDING_WIDTH = 30000   # Width of building (30m)
FLOOR_HEIGHT = 4000      # Floor-to-floor height (4m for office with services)
NUM_FLOORS = 12          # Number of office floors (high-rise)
GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT = 6000  # Double-height lobby
WALL_THICKNESS = 300     # Exterior curtain wall thickness

# Core Configuration (Central services - elevators, stairs, restrooms)
CORE_LENGTH = 15000      # Length of central core (37.5% of building)
CORE_WIDTH = 10000       # Width of central core
CORE_WALL_THICKNESS = 300  # Fire-rated core walls

# Structural System
COLUMN_DIAMETER = 800    # Circular columns
PERIMETER_COLUMN_SPACING = 8000  # 8m spacing (typical for curtain wall)

# Breakout Space Configuration
BREAKOUT_FLOOR_INTERVAL = 4  # Every 4th floor has breakout terrace
TERRACE_SETBACK = 6000   # How far terrace is set back from edge

# Window Configuration
SPANDREL_HEIGHT = 1200   # Solid panel below window (covers slab edge)
VISION_GLASS_HEIGHT = FLOOR_HEIGHT - SPANDREL_HEIGHT - 300

# Foundation
FOUNDATION_HEIGHT = 2500
FOUNDATION_OFFSET = 2000

# Roof
ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS = 400
PARAPET_HEIGHT = 1500

# Colors for visualization
COLOR_GLASS = (0.7, 0.85, 0.95, 0.6)       # Light blue glass (semi-transparent)
COLOR_SPANDREL = (0.2, 0.25, 0.3)          # Dark gray spandrel
COLOR_CORE = (0.7, 0.7, 0.65)              # Concrete gray
COLOR_SLAB = (0.65, 0.65, 0.65)            # Concrete
COLOR_COLUMN = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)             # Steel gray
COLOR_TERRACE = (0.82, 0.78, 0.72)         # Wood/composite deck
COLOR_RAILING = (0.3, 0.3, 0.35)           # Metal railing
COLOR_FOUNDATION = (0.45, 0.45, 0.45)      # Dark concrete

# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

def create_box(length, width, height, name):
    """Create a box with given dimensions"""
    box = Part.makeBox(length, width, height)
    obj = App.ActiveDocument.addObject("Part::Feature", name)
    obj.Shape = box
    return obj

def create_cylinder_at(x, y, z, radius, height, name):
    """Create a cylinder at specific position"""
    cyl = Part.makeCylinder(radius, height, App.Vector(x, y, z), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    obj = App.ActiveDocument.addObject("Part::Feature", name)
    obj.Shape = cyl
    return obj

def create_perimeter_columns(building_length, building_width, z, height, spacing, diameter):
    """Create columns around building perimeter"""
    columns = []
    radius = diameter / 2
    
    # Front columns
    num_front = int(building_length / spacing) + 1
    for i in range(num_front):
        x = i * spacing
        if x <= building_length:
            col = Part.makeCylinder(radius, height, App.Vector(x, radius, z), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
            columns.append(col)
    
    # Back columns
    for i in range(num_front):
        x = i * spacing
        if x <= building_length:
            col = Part.makeCylinder(radius, height, App.Vector(x, building_width - radius, z), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
            columns.append(col)
    
    # Left columns (excluding corners already done)
    num_side = int(building_width / spacing)
    for i in range(1, num_side):
        y = i * spacing
        col = Part.makeCylinder(radius, height, App.Vector(radius, y, z), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
        columns.append(col)
    
    # Right columns (excluding corners already done)
    for i in range(1, num_side):
        y = i * spacing
        col = Part.makeCylinder(radius, height, App.Vector(building_length - radius, y, z), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
        columns.append(col)
    
    return columns

# ============================================================================
# MAIN CONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

# Create new document
doc_name = "CoWorkingTower"
if App.ActiveDocument:
    if App.ActiveDocument.Name != doc_name:
        App.newDocument(doc_name)
else:
    App.newDocument(doc_name)

doc = App.ActiveDocument

print("Creating High-Rise Co-Working Office Tower...")
print(f"Building: {BUILDING_LENGTH/1000}m × {BUILDING_WIDTH/1000}m × {NUM_FLOORS} floors")

# Core position (centered)
core_x = (BUILDING_LENGTH - CORE_LENGTH) / 2
core_y = (BUILDING_WIDTH - CORE_WIDTH) / 2

# ============================================================================
# FOUNDATION
# ============================================================================

foundation = create_box(
    BUILDING_LENGTH + 2 * FOUNDATION_OFFSET,
    BUILDING_WIDTH + 2 * FOUNDATION_OFFSET,
    FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
    "Foundation"
)
foundation.Placement = App.Placement(
    App.Vector(-FOUNDATION_OFFSET, -FOUNDATION_OFFSET, -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT),
    App.Rotation(App.Vector(0, 0, 1), 0)
)
foundation.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_FOUNDATION

# ============================================================================
# GROUND FLOOR - LOBBY
# ============================================================================

print("Creating ground floor lobby...")

ground_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "GroundFloor")

# Ground slab
ground_slab = create_box(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, 300, "GroundSlab")
ground_slab.Placement = App.Placement(App.Vector(0, 0, -300), App.Rotation(0, 0, 0))
ground_slab.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SLAB
ground_group.addObject(ground_slab)

# Perimeter columns at ground
ground_columns = create_perimeter_columns(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, 0, 
                                          GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT, PERIMETER_COLUMN_SPACING, 
                                          COLUMN_DIAMETER)
if ground_columns:
    ground_cols_union = ground_columns[0]
    for col in ground_columns[1:]:
        ground_cols_union = ground_cols_union.fuse(col)
    ground_cols_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Ground_Columns")
    ground_cols_obj.Shape = ground_cols_union
    ground_cols_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_COLUMN
    ground_group.addObject(ground_cols_obj)

# Central core at ground level
core_outer = Part.makeBox(CORE_LENGTH, CORE_WIDTH, GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT,
                          App.Vector(core_x, core_y, 0))
core_inner = Part.makeBox(CORE_LENGTH - 2*CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                          CORE_WIDTH - 2*CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                          GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT + 100,
                          App.Vector(core_x + CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                                     core_y + CORE_WALL_THICKNESS, -50))
core_ground = core_outer.cut(core_inner)
core_ground_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Ground_Core")
core_ground_obj.Shape = core_ground
core_ground_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_CORE
ground_group.addObject(core_ground_obj)

# Glass curtain wall - ground floor (full height glass)
# Front
front_glass = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, WALL_THICKNESS, GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT,
                           App.Vector(0, 0, 0))
front_glass_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Ground_FrontGlass")

# Back

back_glass_obj.Shape = back_glass
back_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
back_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
ground_group.addObject(back_glass_obj)

# Left
left_glass = Part.makeBox(WALL_THICKNESS, BUILDING_WIDTH, GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT,

left_glass_obj.Shape = left_glass
left_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
left_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40

# Right

right_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
right_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
ground_group.addObject(right_glass_obj)

# ============================================================================
# TYPICAL OFFICE FLOORS
# ============================================================================

for floor_num in range(1, NUM_FLOORS + 1):
    z_base = GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT + (floor_num - 1) * FLOOR_HEIGHT
    
    is_breakout_floor = (floor_num % BREAKOUT_FLOOR_INTERVAL == 0)
    
    if is_breakout_floor:

    else:
        print(f"Creating Floor {floor_num} - Office Floor...")
    
    floor_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", f"Floor_{floor_num}")
    
    # Floor slab
    floor_slab = create_box(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, 200, f"Floor{floor_num}_Slab")
    floor_slab.Placement = App.Placement(App.Vector(0, 0, z_base - 200), App.Rotation(0, 0, 0))
    floor_slab.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SLAB
    floor_group.addObject(floor_slab)
    
    # Perimeter columns
    columns = create_perimeter_columns(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, z_base,
                                       FLOOR_HEIGHT, PERIMETER_COLUMN_SPACING, 
                                       COLUMN_DIAMETER)
    if columns:
        cols_union = columns[0]
        for col in columns[1:]:
            cols_union = cols_union.fuse(col)
        cols_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_Columns")
        cols_obj.Shape = cols_union
        cols_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_COLUMN
        floor_group.addObject(cols_obj)
    
    # Central core
    core_outer = Part.makeBox(CORE_LENGTH, CORE_WIDTH, FLOOR_HEIGHT,
                              App.Vector(core_x, core_y, z_base))
    core_inner = Part.makeBox(CORE_LENGTH - 2*CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                              CORE_WIDTH - 2*CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                              FLOOR_HEIGHT + 100,
                              App.Vector(core_x + CORE_WALL_THICKNESS,
                                         core_y + CORE_WALL_THICKNESS, z_base - 50))
    core_walls = core_outer.cut(core_inner)
    core_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_Core")
    core_obj.Shape = core_walls
    core_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_CORE
    floor_group.addObject(core_obj)
    
    # Spandrel panels (solid lower portion of facade)
    # Front spandrel
    front_spandrel = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, WALL_THICKNESS, SPANDREL_HEIGHT,
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, z_base))
    front_spandrel_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_FrontSpandrel")
    front_spandrel_obj.Shape = front_spandrel
    front_spandrel_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SPANDREL
    floor_group.addObject(front_spandrel_obj)
    
    # Back spandrel
    back_spandrel = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, WALL_THICKNESS, SPANDREL_HEIGHT,
                                 App.Vector(0, BUILDING_WIDTH - WALL_THICKNESS, z_base))
    back_spandrel_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_BackSpandrel")
    back_spandrel_obj.Shape = back_spandrel
    back_spandrel_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SPANDREL
    floor_group.addObject(back_spandrel_obj)
    
    # Left spandrel
    left_spandrel = Part.makeBox(WALL_THICKNESS, BUILDING_WIDTH, SPANDREL_HEIGHT,
                                 App.Vector(0, 0, z_base))
    left_spandrel_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_LeftSpandrel")
    left_spandrel_obj.Shape = left_spandrel
    left_spandrel_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SPANDREL
    floor_group.addObject(left_spandrel_obj)
    
    # Right spandrel
    right_spandrel = Part.makeBox(WALL_THICKNESS, BUILDING_WIDTH, SPANDREL_HEIGHT,
                                  App.Vector(BUILDING_LENGTH - WALL_THICKNESS, 0, z_base))
    right_spandrel_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_RightSpandrel")
    right_spandrel_obj.Shape = right_spandrel
    right_spandrel_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SPANDREL
    floor_group.addObject(right_spandrel_obj)
    
    # Vision glass (upper portion of facade)
    glass_z = z_base + SPANDREL_HEIGHT
    
    # Front glass
    front_glass = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, WALL_THICKNESS, VISION_GLASS_HEIGHT,
                               App.Vector(0, 0, glass_z))
    front_glass_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_FrontGlass")
    front_glass_obj.Shape = front_glass
    front_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
    front_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
    floor_group.addObject(front_glass_obj)
    
    # Back glass
    back_glass = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, WALL_THICKNESS, VISION_GLASS_HEIGHT,
                              App.Vector(0, BUILDING_WIDTH - WALL_THICKNESS, glass_z))
    back_glass_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_BackGlass")
    back_glass_obj.Shape = back_glass
    back_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
    back_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
    floor_group.addObject(back_glass_obj)
    
    # Left glass
    left_glass = Part.makeBox(WALL_THICKNESS, BUILDING_WIDTH, VISION_GLASS_HEIGHT,
                              App.Vector(0, 0, glass_z))
    left_glass_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_LeftGlass")
    left_glass_obj.Shape = left_glass
    left_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
    left_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
    floor_group.addObject(left_glass_obj)
    
    # Right glass
    right_glass = Part.makeBox(WALL_THICKNESS, BUILDING_WIDTH, VISION_GLASS_HEIGHT,
                               App.Vector(BUILDING_LENGTH - WALL_THICKNESS, 0, glass_z))
    right_glass_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_RightGlass")
    right_glass_obj.Shape = right_glass
    right_glass_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_GLASS
    right_glass_obj.ViewObject.Transparency = 40
    floor_group.addObject(right_glass_obj)
    
    # Breakout terrace (if applicable)
    if is_breakout_floor:
        # Terrace slab (setback from edge)
        terrace_length = BUILDING_LENGTH - 2 * TERRACE_SETBACK
        terrace_width = BUILDING_WIDTH * 0.4
        terrace_x = TERRACE_SETBACK
        terrace_y = BUILDING_WIDTH - terrace_width
        
        terrace_slab = Part.makeBox(terrace_length, terrace_width, 150,
                                    App.Vector(terrace_x, terrace_y, z_base - 150))
        terrace_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_Terrace")
        terrace_obj.Shape = terrace_slab
        terrace_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_TERRACE
        floor_group.addObject(terrace_obj)
        
        # Terrace railing (1100mm height)
        railing_height = 1100
        railing_thickness = 100
        
        # Front railing
        railing_front = Part.makeBox(terrace_length, railing_thickness, railing_height,
                                     App.Vector(terrace_x, terrace_y, z_base))
        # Side railings
        railing_left = Part.makeBox(railing_thickness, terrace_width, railing_height,
                                    App.Vector(terrace_x, terrace_y, z_base))
        railing_right = Part.makeBox(railing_thickness, terrace_width, railing_height,
                                     App.Vector(terrace_x + terrace_length - railing_thickness,
                                                terrace_y, z_base))
        
        railings = railing_front.fuse(railing_left).fuse(railing_right)
        railing_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", f"Floor{floor_num}_Railing")
        railing_obj.Shape = railings
        railing_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_RAILING
        floor_group.addObject(railing_obj)
        
        # Remove back glass where terrace extends
        back_glass_obj.Shape = back_glass_obj.Shape.cut(
            Part.makeBox(terrace_length, WALL_THICKNESS + 10, FLOOR_HEIGHT,
                         App.Vector(terrace_x, terrace_y - 5, z_base))
        )
        back_spandrel_obj.Shape = back_spandrel_obj.Shape.cut(
            Part.makeBox(terrace_length, WALL_THICKNESS + 10, SPANDREL_HEIGHT,
                         App.Vector(terrace_x, terrace_y - 5, z_base))
        )

# ============================================================================
# ROOF
# ============================================================================

print("Creating roof...")

roof_z = GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT + NUM_FLOORS * FLOOR_HEIGHT

# Roof slab
roof_slab = create_box(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS, "RoofSlab")
roof_slab.Placement = App.Placement(App.Vector(0, 0, roof_z), App.Rotation(0, 0, 0))
roof_slab.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_SLAB

# Roof parapet
parapet_outer = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH, BUILDING_WIDTH, PARAPET_HEIGHT,
                             App.Vector(0, 0, roof_z + ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS))
parapet_inner = Part.makeBox(BUILDING_LENGTH - 2*WALL_THICKNESS,
                             BUILDING_WIDTH - 2*WALL_THICKNESS,
                             PARAPET_HEIGHT + 100,
                             App.Vector(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_THICKNESS,
                                        roof_z + ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS - 50))
parapet = parapet_outer.cut(parapet_inner)
parapet_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "RoofParapet")
parapet_obj.Shape = parapet
parapet_obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_CORE

# Mechanical penthouse (elevator overrun and HVAC)
penthouse = create_box(CORE_LENGTH, CORE_WIDTH, 3000, "MechanicalPenthouse")
penthouse.Placement = App.Placement(
    App.Vector(core_x, core_y, roof_z + ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS),
    App.Rotation(0, 0, 0)
)
penthouse.ViewObject.ShapeColor = COLOR_CORE

# ============================================================================
# SITE ELEMENTS
# ============================================================================

# Entry plaza
plaza = create_box(BUILDING_LENGTH, 12000, 100, "EntryPlaza")
plaza.Placement = App.Placement(
    App.Vector(0, -12000, -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT - 100),
    App.Rotation(0, 0, 0)
)
plaza.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.4, 0.4, 0.4)

# Landscaping
landscape = create_box(BUILDING_LENGTH + 10000, BUILDING_WIDTH + 10000, 80, "Landscape")
landscape.Placement = App.Placement(
    App.Vector(-5000, -5000, -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT - 180),
    App.Rotation(0, 0, 0)
)
landscape.ViewObject.ShapeColor = (0.2, 0.5, 0.2)

# Recompute
doc.recompute()

# ============================================================================
# STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

total_height = GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT + NUM_FLOORS * FLOOR_HEIGHT + ROOF_SLAB_THICKNESS + PARAPET_HEIGHT
floor_area = (BUILDING_LENGTH * BUILDING_WIDTH) / 1_000_000
core_area = (CORE_LENGTH * CORE_WIDTH) / 1_000_000
usable_area = floor_area - core_area
total_office_area = usable_area * NUM_FLOORS
num_breakout_floors = NUM_FLOORS // BREAKOUT_FLOOR_INTERVAL

print("\n" + "="*75)
print("HIGH-RISE CO-WORKING OFFICE TOWER CREATED SUCCESSFULLY!")
print("="*75)
print(f"\nBuilding Statistics:")
print(f"  Footprint: {BUILDING_LENGTH/1000}m × {BUILDING_WIDTH/1000}m = {floor_area:.0f}m²")
print(f"  Number of Floors: {NUM_FLOORS} office + 1 ground lobby")
print(f"  Total Height: {total_height/1000:.1f}m (to parapet)")
print(f"  Floor-to-Floor: {FLOOR_HEIGHT/1000:.1f}m")
print(f"  Ground Floor: {GROUND_FLOOR_HEIGHT/1000:.1f}m (double height)")
print(f"\nFloor Plate Efficiency:")
print(f"  Gross Floor Area: {floor_area:.0f}m²")
print(f"  Core Area: {core_area:.0f}m² ({core_area/floor_area*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  Usable Office Area: {usable_area:.0f}m² per floor")
print(f"  Total Office Area: {total_office_area:.0f}m²")
print(f"\nCo-Working Features:")
print(f"  ✓ Flexible open floor plates ({usable_area:.0f}m² per floor)")
print(f"  ✓ Column-free perimeter with {PERIMETER_COLUMN_SPACING/1000}m spacing")
print(f"  ✓ Central core for efficient circulation")
print(f"  ✓ Breakout terraces every {BREAKOUT_FLOOR_INTERVAL} floors ({num_breakout_floors} total)")
print(f"  ✓ Floor-to-ceiling glazing with curtain wall")
print(f"  ✓ Spandrel panels for MEP concealment")

print(f"  ✓ Perimeter columns: {COLUMN_DIAMETER}mm diameter")
print(f"  ✓ Column spacing: {PERIMETER_COLUMN_SPACING/1000}m")
print(f"  ✓ Core-supported floors for open plan flexibility")
print(f"\nSustainability:")
print(f"  ✓ Maximum natural daylighting")
print(f"  ✓ Outdoor breakout spaces for wellness")

prompt: Design a tall office tower with intermediate sky lobbies and vertical zoning.
script:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import Draft
import math

# Create new document
doc = App.newDocument("SkyLobbyOfficeTower")

# ========================================
# PARAMETRIC VARIABLES - Adjust these for different designs
# ========================================

# Building dimensions (in mm)
floor_plate_width = 45000  # 45m wide floor plate
floor_plate_depth = 35000  # 35m deep
total_floors = 80  # 80-story supertall tower
floor_to_floor_height = 3900  # 3.9m typical floor height

# Sky lobby configuration (critical feature)
num_sky_lobbies = 3  # Multiple sky lobbies for vertical zoning
sky_lobby_floors = [20, 44, 64]  # Floor numbers for sky lobbies
sky_lobby_height = 6000  # 6m double-height sky lobbies

# Vertical zoning (based on sky lobby system)
# Zone 1: Floors 1-20 (Ground to Sky Lobby 1)
# Zone 2: Floors 21-44 (Sky Lobby 1 to Sky Lobby 2)
# Zone 3: Floors 45-64 (Sky Lobby 2 to Sky Lobby 3)
# Zone 4: Floors 65-80 (Sky Lobby 3 to Top)

# Core dimensions
core_width = 18000  # 18m wide core (larger for express elevators)
core_depth = 20000  # 20m deep core

# Wall thicknesses
exterior_wall_thickness = 350  # 350mm curtain wall
core_wall_thickness = 400  # 400mm reinforced concrete core

# Foundation
foundation_depth = 4000  # 4m deep mat foundation
pile_depth = 25000  # 25m deep piles to bedrock

# Ground floor and podium
ground_floor_height = 8000  # 8m tall ground floor lobby
podium_floors = 5  # 5-floor retail/amenity podium
podium_setback = 5000  # 5m setback after podium

# Express elevator configuration
express_elevators = 6  # 6 express elevators to sky lobbies
local_elevators_per_zone = 8  # 8 local elevators per zone

# Elevator dimensions
express_elevator_width = 2800  # Larger express elevators
express_elevator_depth = 2800
local_elevator_width = 2200
local_elevator_depth = 2200

# Structural elements
mega_column_size = 2000  # 2m x 2m mega columns
outrigger_floors = [25, 50, 75]  # Outrigger floors for stability

# Curtain wall
window_module = 1500  # 1.5m module
spandrel_height = 900  # 900mm spandrel

# Roof
roof_slab_thickness = 500  # 500mm roof slab
crown_height = 8000  # 8m architectural crown
antenna_height = 12000  # 12m antenna spire

# Amenities in sky lobbies
sky_garden_depth = 8000  # 8m deep sky gardens
conference_room_size = 6000  # 6m x 6m conference rooms

# Site
plaza_size = floor_plate_width + 30000

# ========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ========================================

def create_box(x, y, z, w, d, h, name):
    """Create a box at position with dimensions"""
    box = Part.makeBox(w, d, h, App.Vector(x, y, z))
    obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", name)
    obj.Shape = box
    return obj

def get_floor_height(floor_num):
    """Get height for specific floor based on type"""
    if floor_num == 0:
        return ground_floor_height
    elif floor_num in sky_lobby_floors:
        return sky_lobby_height
    else:
        return floor_to_floor_height

def get_floor_z(floor_num):
    """Calculate Z height for a given floor"""
    z = 0
    for f in range(floor_num):
        z += get_floor_height(f)
    return z

# ========================================
# DEEP FOUNDATION WITH PILES
# ========================================

foundation = create_box(
    -6000, -6000, -foundation_depth,
    floor_plate_width + 12000,
    floor_plate_depth + 12000,
    foundation_depth,
    "MatFoundation"
)

# Foundation piles to bedrock
pile_spacing = 10000
num_piles_x = int((floor_plate_width + 12000) / pile_spacing)
num_piles_y = int((floor_plate_depth + 12000) / pile_spacing)

for i in range(num_piles_x):
    for j in range(num_piles_y):
        pile_x = -6000 + i * pile_spacing
        pile_y = -6000 + j * pile_spacing
        pile = create_box(
            pile_x, pile_y, -foundation_depth - pile_depth,
            800, 800, pile_depth,
            f"Pile_{i}_{j}"
        )

# ========================================
# CENTRAL CORE (FULL HEIGHT)
# ========================================

core_x = (floor_plate_width - core_width) / 2
core_y = (floor_plate_depth - core_depth) / 2
total_height = get_floor_z(total_floors)

central_core = create_box(
    core_x, core_y, 0,
    core_width, core_depth, total_height,
    "CentralCore"
)

# ========================================
# EXPRESS ELEVATORS (Serve all sky lobbies)
# ========================================

# Express elevators - only stop at ground and sky lobbies
express_start_x = core_x + 2000
express_start_y = core_y + 2000

for express_num in range(express_elevators):
    row = express_num // 3
    col = express_num % 3
    
    elev_x = express_start_x + col * (express_elevator_width + 800)
    elev_y = express_start_y + row * (express_elevator_depth + 800)
    
    elevator = create_box(
        elev_x, elev_y, 0,
        express_elevator_width, express_elevator_depth, total_height,
        f"ExpressElevator_{express_num+1}"
    )

# ========================================
# LOCAL ELEVATORS (One set per zone)
# ========================================

# Zone 1: Ground to Sky Lobby 1 (Floor 20)
zone1_height = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[0] + 1)
local_start_x = core_x + core_width - local_elevator_width * 4 - 3000
local_start_y = core_y + 2000

for local_num in range(local_elevators_per_zone):
    row = local_num // 4
    col = local_num % 4
    
    elev_x = local_start_x + col * (local_elevator_width + 400)
    elev_y = local_start_y + row * (local_elevator_depth + 400)
    
    elevator = create_box(
        elev_x, elev_y, 0,
        local_elevator_width, local_elevator_depth, zone1_height,
        f"LocalElevator_Zone1_{local_num+1}"
    )

# Zone 2: Sky Lobby 1 to Sky Lobby 2
zone2_start = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[0])
zone2_height = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[1] + 1) - zone2_start

for local_num in range(local_elevators_per_zone):
    row = local_num // 4
    col = local_num % 4
    
    elev_x = local_start_x + col * (local_elevator_width + 400)
    elev_y = local_start_y + row * (local_elevator_depth + 400)
    
    elevator = create_box(
        elev_x, elev_y, zone2_start,
        local_elevator_width, local_elevator_depth, zone2_height,
        f"LocalElevator_Zone2_{local_num+1}"
    )

# Zone 3: Sky Lobby 2 to Sky Lobby 3
zone3_start = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[1])
zone3_height = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[2] + 1) - zone3_start

for local_num in range(local_elevators_per_zone):
    row = local_num // 4
    col = local_num % 4
    
    elev_x = local_start_x + col * (local_elevator_width + 400)
    elev_y = local_start_y + row * (local_elevator_depth + 400)
    
    elevator = create_box(
        elev_x, elev_y, zone3_start,
        local_elevator_width, local_elevator_depth, zone3_height,
        f"LocalElevator_Zone3_{local_num+1}"
    )

# Zone 4: Sky Lobby 3 to Top
zone4_start = get_floor_z(sky_lobby_floors[2])
zone4_height = total_height - zone4_start

for local_num in range(local_elevators_per_zone):
    row = local_num // 4
    col = local_num % 4
    
    elev_x = local_start_x + col * (local_elevator_width + 400)
    elev_y = local_start_y + row * (local_elevator_depth + 400)
    
    elevator = create_box(
        elev_x, elev_y, zone4_start,
        local_elevator_width, local_elevator_depth, zone4_height,
        f"LocalElevator_Zone4_{local_num+1}"
    )

# ========================================
# FIRE STAIRS (Full height, code required)
# ========================================

stair_positions = [
    (core_x + 1000, core_y + 1000),
    (core_x + core_width - 2500 - 1000, core_y + 1000),
    (core_x + 1000, core_y + core_depth - 3500 - 1000),
    (core_x + core_width - 2500 - 1000, core_y + core_depth - 3500 - 1000)
]

for idx, (stair_x, stair_y) in enumerate(stair_positions):
    stairwell = create_box(

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import math
import os

doc = App.newDocument("InstitutionalBuildingComplex")

# Editable parameters
floor_count = 9
block_length = 110000
block_width = 20000
floor_height = 3600
inter_block_spacing = 24000
skybridge_level = 4
skybridge_span = 26000
skybridge_width = 7000
column_grid = 7500
foundation_type = "raft"  # "raft" or "pile"

# Validate input parameters
def validate_parameters():
    if floor_count < 2:
        raise ValueError("Floor count must be at least 2")
    if block_length < 30000:
        raise ValueError("Block length too small")
    if floor_height < 2500:
        raise ValueError("Floor height too small")
    if skybridge_level >= floor_count:
        raise ValueError("Skybridge level exceeds floor count")
    if foundation_type not in ["raft", "pile"]:
        raise ValueError("Invalid foundation type")

try:
    validate_parameters()
except ValueError as e:
    App.Console.PrintError(f"Parameter validation failed: {str(e)}\n")
    raise

# Foundation creation
def create_foundation(x_offset, y_offset, length, width, thickness):
    try:
        if foundation_type == "raft":
            foundation = Part.makeBox(length, width, thickness)
            foundation.translate(App.Vector(x_offset, y_offset, -thickness))
            return foundation
        else:  # pile foundation
            piles = []
            pile_spacing = 6000
            pile_diameter = 800
            pile_depth = 15000

            for x in range(0, length, pile_spacing):
                for y in range(0, width, pile_spacing):
                    pile = Part.makeCylinder(pile_diameter/2, pile_depth)
                    pile.translate(App.Vector(x_offset + x, y_offset + y, -pile_depth))
                    piles.append(pile)

            return Part.Compound(piles) if piles else None
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Foundation creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return None

# Structural core creation
def create_structural_core(x_offset, y_offset, z_offset, core_size, height):
    try:
        core = Part.makeBox(core_size, core_size, height)
        core.translate(App.Vector(x_offset - core_size/2, y_offset - core_size/2, z_offset))
        return core
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Core creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return None

# Floor slab creation
def create_floor_slab(x_offset, y_offset, z_pos, length, width, thickness):
    try:
        slab = Part.makeBox(length, width, thickness)
        slab.translate(App.Vector(x_offset, y_offset, z_pos))
        return slab
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Slab creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return None

# Column creation
def create_columns(x_offset, y_offset, z_offset, height, grid_spacing, length, width):
    try:
        columns = []
        for x in range(0, length, grid_spacing):
            for y in range(0, width, grid_spacing):
                if x > 0 and x < length - grid_spacing and y > 0 and y < width - grid_spacing:
                    column = Part.makeBox(600, 600, height)
                    column.translate(App.Vector(x_offset + x, y_offset + y, z_offset))
                    columns.append(column)
        return Part.Compound(columns) if columns else None
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Column creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return None

# Facade creation
def create_facade(x_offset, y_offset, length, width, height, floor_height):
    try:
        facade_elements = []
        panel_width = 1500
        panel_height = floor_height
        window_width = 1200
        window_height = 1500
        window_spacing = 3000

        for floor in range(floor_count):
            z_pos = floor * floor_height
            for x in range(0, length, panel_width):
                # Terracotta panels
                panel = Part.makeBox(panel_width, width, panel_height)
                panel.translate(App.Vector(x_offset + x, y_offset, z_pos))
                facade_elements.append(panel)

                # Windows
                if floor > 0 or x % window_spacing == 0:
                    window = Part.makeBox(window_width, window_height, 200)
                    window.translate(App.Vector(x_offset + x + 150, y_offset + width/2 - window_height/2, z_pos + 1000))
                    facade_elements.append(window)

        return facade_elements
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Facade creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return []

# Skybridge creation
def create_skywalk(level, span_length, width, height):
    try:
        skywalk_elements = []
        z_pos = level * floor_height
        truss_height = 2000
        truss_depth = 1000

        # Steel truss structure
        for i in range(0, span_length, 3000):
            # Top chord
            top_chord = Part.makeBox(200, 200, span_length)
            top_chord.translate(App.Vector(0, width/2 - 100, z_pos + height - 100))
            skywalk_elements.append(top_chord)

            # Bottom chord
            bottom_chord = Part.makeBox(200, 200, span_length)
            bottom_chord.translate(App.Vector(0, width/2 - 100, z_pos + height - truss_height - 100))
            skywalk_elements.append(bottom_chord)

            # Diagonal members
            diagonal = Part.makeBox(200, 200, math.sqrt(3000**2 + truss_height**2))
            diagonal.rotate(App.Vector(0,0,0), App.Vector(0,1,0), -math.atan(truss_height/3000))
            diagonal.translate(App.Vector(i, width/2 - 100, z_pos + height - truss_height - 100))
            skywalk_elements.append(diagonal)

        # RCC deck
        deck = Part.makeBox(span_length, width, 300)
        deck.translate(App.Vector(0, 0, z_pos + height - 300))
        skywalk_elements.append(deck)

        # Glass curtain wall
        glazing = Part.makeBox(span_length, width, height - 600)
        glazing.translate(App.Vector(0, 0, z_pos + 300))
        skywalk_elements.append(glazing)

        return skywalk_elements
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Skywalk creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return []

# Stair core creation
def create_stair_core(x_offset, y_offset, z_offset, width, depth, height):
    try:
        core_elements = []

        # Core structure
        core = Part.makeBox(width, depth, height)
        core.translate(App.Vector(x_offset, y_offset, z_offset))
        core_elements.append(core)

        # Full-height glass
        glass = Part.makeBox(width, 200, height)
        glass.translate(App.Vector(x_offset + width, y_offset, z_offset))
        core_elements.append(glass)

        return core_elements
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Stair core creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return []

# Roof creation
def create_roof(x_offset, y_offset, length, width, height):
    try:
        roof_elements = []

        # Flat roof with overhang
        roof = Part.makeBox(length + 2000, width + 2000, 500)
        roof.translate(App.Vector(x_offset - 1000, y_offset - 1000, height - 500))
        roof_elements.append(roof)

        # Steel lattice pergola
        for i in range(0, length + 2000, 3000):
            beam = Part.makeBox(200, 200, length + 2000)
            beam.translate(App.Vector(x_offset - 1000, y_offset - 1000 + i, height - 300))
            roof_elements.append(beam)

        return roof_elements
    except Exception as e:
        App.Console.PrintError(f"Roof creation error: {str(e)}\n")
        return []

# HVAC services creation
def create_hvac(x_offset, y_offset, length, width, height):
    try:
        hvac_elements = []

        # Concealed HVAC units
        for floor in range(1, floor_count):

prompt: Design a parametric institutional academic complex consisting of two parallel 9-story blocks connected by a steel truss skybridge, featuring terracotta facades, a central courtyard, and IFC export capabilities.
script:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import math
import os

doc = App.newDocument("InstitutionalBuildingComplex")

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION & AESTHETICS ---
params = {
    "block_length": 110000,
    "block_width": 20000,
    "block_height": 32400,
    "floor_height": 3600,
    "plinth_height": 600,  # Lift building off ground
    "skybridge_level": 4,
    "skybridge_span": 24000,
    "skybridge_width": 6000,
    "col_spacing": 7500,
    "louver_depth": 400,
    "louver_thick": 100,
    "parapet_height": 1200
}

# Color Palette (RGB tuples 0-1)
colors = {
    "concrete": (0.7, 0.7, 0.7),
    "terracotta": (0.8, 0.4, 0.3),  # Reddish brown for facade
    "glass": (0.6, 0.8, 0.9),       # Light blue transparent
    "steel": (0.3, 0.3, 0.35),      # Dark metallic
    "wood": (0.6, 0.4, 0.2),
    "grass": (0.2, 0.6, 0.2),
    "solar": (0.1, 0.1, 0.4)
}

# --- 2. GEOMETRY HELPERS (OPTIMIZED) ---

def make_box_at(l, w, h, x, y, z):
    b = Part.makeBox(l, w, h)
    b.translate(App.Vector(x, y, z))
    return b

def create_grid_structure(x_off, y_off, length, width, height):
    """Creates columns and beams as a single compound for performance."""
    solids = []
    
    # Columns
    col_size = 600
    for x in range(0, length + 1, params["col_spacing"]):
        for y in range(0, width + 1, params["col_spacing"]):
            # Continuous column from bottom to top for structural integrity look
            col = make_box_at(col_size, col_size, height, x_off + x, y_off + y, params["plinth_height"])
            solids.append(col)

    # Beams (Per floor)
    beam_depth = 600
    for z in range(params["floor_height"], height + 1, params["floor_height"]):
        current_z = z + params["plinth_height"] - beam_depth
        
        # Long beams (X-axis)
        for y in range(0, width + 1, params["col_spacing"]):
            beam = make_box_at(length + col_size, col_size, beam_depth, x_off, y_off + y, current_z)
            solids.append(beam)
            
        # Cross beams (Y-axis)
        for x in range(0, length + 1, params["col_spacing"]):
            beam = make_box_at(col_size, width, beam_depth, x_off + x, y_off, current_z)
            solids.append(beam)

    return Part.Compound(solids)

def create_slabs(x_off, y_off, length, width, height):
    slabs = []
    for z in range(0, height, params["floor_height"]):
        # Floor slab
        s = make_box_at(length, width, 200, x_off, y_off, z + params["plinth_height"])
        slabs.append(s)
        # Ceiling/Plenum space
    return Part.Compound(slabs)

def create_louvred_facade(x_off, y_off, length, width, height, orientation="front"):
    """Creates vertical fins/brise-soleil for academic look."""
    elements = []
    spacing = 1200 # Spacing of fins
    
    # Decide range based on orientation
    if orientation == "front":
        range_x = range(0, length, spacing)
        y_pos = y_off - params["louver_depth"]
        rot = 0
    elif orientation == "back":
        range_x = range(0, length, spacing)
        y_pos = y_off + width
        rot = 0
    
    for x in range_x:
        # Create a vertical fin
        fin = make_box_at(params["louver_thick"], params["louver_depth"], height - params["floor_height"], 
                          x_off + x, y_pos, params["plinth_height"] + params["floor_height"]) # Skip ground floor
        elements.append(fin)
        
        # Horizontal shelf every floor (light shelf)
        for z in range(params["floor_height"], height, params["floor_height"]):
             shelf = make_box_at(spacing, params["louver_depth"]-50, 50, 
                                 x_off + x, y_pos, z + params["plinth_height"])
             elements.append(shelf)

    return Part.Compound(elements)

def create_glazing_curtain(x_off, y_off, length, width, height):
    """Creates the glass volume behind the louvers."""
    # We cheat slightly by making a big glass box, intersecting with floors later visually
    glass_thickness = 50
    
    # Front Glass
    g1 = make_box_at(length, glass_thickness, height, x_off, y_off, params["plinth_height"])
    # Back Glass
    g2 = make_box_at(length, glass_thickness, height, x_off, y_off + width - glass_thickness, params["plinth_height"])
    # Side Glass
    g3 = make_box_at(glass_thickness, width, height, x_off, y_off, params["plinth_height"])
    g4 = make_box_at(glass_thickness, width, height, x_off + length - glass_thickness, y_off, params["plinth_height"])
    
    return Part.Compound([g1, g2, g3, g4])

def create_parapet(x_off, y_off, length, width, height):
    """Hides the roof clutter."""
    z = height + params["plinth_height"]
    thick = 300
    h = params["parapet_height"]
    
    p1 = make_box_at(length, thick, h, x_off, y_off, z)
    p2 = make_box_at(length, thick, h, x_off, y_off + width - thick, z)
    p3 = make_box_at(thick, width - 2*thick, h, x_off, y_off + thick, z)
    p4 = make_box_at(thick, width - 2*thick, h, x_off + length - thick, y_off + thick, z)
    
    return Part.Compound([p1, p2, p3, p4])

def create_entrance_porch(x_off, y_off, building_width):
    """A grand entrance canopy."""
    width = 12000
    depth = 8000
    height = 5000 # Double heightish
    
    # Canopy Slab
    slab = make_box_at(width, depth, 500, x_off - width/2, y_off - depth, params["plinth_height"] + height)
    
    # Large Columns
    c1 = make_box_at(800, 800, height, x_off - width/2 + 500, y_off - depth + 500, params["plinth_height"])
    c2 = make_box_at(800, 800, height, x_off + width/2 - 1300, y_off - depth + 500, params["plinth_height"])
    
    # Entrance Steps
    steps = []
    for i in range(4):
        s = make_box_at(width + 2000, depth/2 + i*300, 150, x_off - width/2 - 1000, y_off - depth, i*150)
        steps.append(s)
        
    return Part.Compound([slab, c1, c2] + steps)

def create_skybridge_refined(x_start, x_end, y_pos, z_level):
    """Connects the two blocks."""
    span = x_end - x_start
    width = params["skybridge_width"]
    height = 4000
    z_base = z_level * params["floor_height"] + params["plinth_height"]
    
    # Floor
    floor = make_box_at(span, width, 300, x_start, y_pos + (20000 - width)/2, z_base)
    
    # Roof
    roof = make_box_at(span, width, 300, x_start, y_pos + (20000 - width)/2, z_base + height)
    
    # Glass Walls
    wall1 = make_box_at(span, 50, height, x_start, y_pos + (20000 - width)/2, z_base)
    wall2 = make_box_at(span, 50, height, x_start, y_pos + (20000 - width)/2 + width, z_base)
    
    # Trusses (Simplified diagonals)
    trusses = []
    num_bays = int(span / 4000)
    for i in range(num_bays):
        # Diagonal
        diag = Part.makeBox(200, 200, math.sqrt(4000**2 + 4000**2))
        diag.rotate(App.Vector(0,0,0), App.Vector(0,1,0), 45)
        diag.translate(App.Vector(x_start + i*4000, y_pos + (20000 - width)/2, z_base))
        trusses.append(diag)
        
    return Part.Compound([floor, roof, wall1, wall2] + trusses)

def create_core(x_off, y_off, h):
    """Elevator/Stair core - Solid concrete."""
    return make_box_at(6000, 6000, h, x_off + params["block_length"]/2 - 3000, y_off + params["block_width"]/2 - 3000, params["plinth_height"])

# --- 3. MAIN BUILDER ---

try:
    App.Console.PrintMessage("Generating Institutional Complex... This may take a few seconds.\n")
    
    # Coordinates
    bx_A = 0
    bx_B = params["block_length"] + params["skybridge_span"]
    
    # ---------------- BLOCK A ----------------
    
    # 1. Structure
    struct_A = create_grid_structure(bx_A, 0, params["block_length"], params["block_width"], params["block_height"])
    obj_struct_A = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Structure_A")
    obj_struct_A.Shape = struct_A
    obj_struct_A.ViewObject.ShapeColor = colors["concrete"]
    
    # 2. Slabs
    slabs_A = create_slabs(bx_A, 0, params["block_length"], params["block_width"], params["block_height"])
    obj_slabs_A = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Slabs_A")
    obj_slabs_A.Shape = slabs_A
    obj_slabs_A.ViewObject.ShapeColor = colors["concrete"]
    
    # 3. Facade (Louvers)
    facade_A = create_louvred_facade(bx_A, 0, params["block_length"], params["block_width"], params["block_height"], "front")

import FreeCAD as App
import Part
import math

# Create document
doc = App.newDocument("TurbineRotorAssembly")

# ── Parameters Spreadsheet ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
sheet = doc.addObject('Spreadsheet::Sheet', 'Parameters')
sheet.set('A1', '200');  sheet.setAlias('A1', 'HubDiameter')
sheet.set('A2', '50');   sheet.setAlias('A2', 'HubThickness')
sheet.set('A3', '500');  sheet.setAlias('A3', 'BladeLength')
sheet.set('A4', '80');   sheet.setAlias('A4', 'BladeChordRoot')
sheet.set('A5', '40');   sheet.setAlias('A5', 'BladeChordTip')
sheet.set('A6', '60');   sheet.setAlias('A6', 'ShaftDiameter')
sheet.set('A7', '300');  sheet.setAlias('A7', 'ShaftLength')
sheet.set('A8', '250');  sheet.setAlias('A8', 'BoltCircleDia')
sheet.set('A9', '30');   sheet.setAlias('A9', 'BladePitch')
sheet.set('A10', '10');  sheet.setAlias('A10', 'BoltDiameter')
doc.recompute()

# ── Derived parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HUB_R          = 100.0   # mm  hub radius
HUB_T          = 50.0    # mm  hub thickness
BLADE_LEN      = 500.0   # mm
CHORD_ROOT     = 80.0    # mm
CHORD_TIP      = 40.0    # mm
PITCH_DEG      = 30.0    # degrees
SHAFT_R        = 30.0    # mm
SHAFT_LEN      = 300.0   # mm
FLANGE_R       = 140.0   # mm  flange outer radius
FLANGE_T       = 20.0    # mm  flange thickness
BOLT_CIRCLE_R  = 125.0   # mm  bolt circle radius (250mm dia / 2)
BOLT_R         = 5.5     # mm  M10 clearance hole radius
N_BLADES       = 3
N_BOLTS        = 8

# ── Assembly root ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
assembly = doc.addObject('App::Part', 'TurbineRotorAssembly')

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  HUB
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Main hub disc
hub_outer = Part.makeCylinder(HUB_R, HUB_T, App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Central bore for shaft (60mm dia + 0.05mm running clearance)
hub_bore = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 0.05, HUB_T + 2,
                              App.Vector(0, 0, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
hub_shape = hub_outer.cut(hub_bore)

# Blade attachment slots – rectangular pockets at 120° spacing
# Each slot is 85mm wide × 20mm deep × 50mm tall (full hub thickness)
SLOT_W = CHORD_ROOT + 5.0   # slightly wider than root chord
SLOT_D = 20.0
for i in range(N_BLADES):
    ang = math.radians(i * 120.0)
    # Slot centre at hub edge
    cx = (HUB_R - SLOT_D / 2) * math.cos(ang)
    cy = (HUB_R - SLOT_D / 2) * math.sin(ang)
    slot = Part.makeBox(SLOT_W, SLOT_D, HUB_T + 2,
                        App.Vector(cx - SLOT_W / 2, cy - SLOT_D / 2, -1))
    slot.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), math.degrees(ang))
    hub_shape = hub_shape.cut(slot)

# Chamfer top/bottom edges of hub bore (fatigue relief)
# Represented as a small chamfer cylinder ring
for z_pos in [0.0, HUB_T - 2.0]:
    chamfer_ring = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 2.0, 2.0,
                                      App.Vector(0, 0, z_pos), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    chamfer_cone_cut = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 0.05, 2.0,
                                          App.Vector(0, 0, z_pos), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    # already cut by bore; just note chamfer geometry is implicit

# Lightening holes in hub body (6 holes on 70mm radius)
for i in range(6):
    ang = math.radians(i * 60.0 + 30.0)
    lx = 70.0 * math.cos(ang)
    ly = 70.0 * math.sin(ang)
    lhole = Part.makeCylinder(12.0, HUB_T + 2,
                               App.Vector(lx, ly, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    hub_shape = hub_shape.cut(lhole)

hub_obj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', 'Hub')
hub_obj.Shape = hub_shape
hub_obj.Label = 'Hub'
hub_obj.Label2 = 'Material: Aluminum Alloy 6061-T6'
assembly.addObject(hub_obj)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  BLADES  (NACA-style airfoil, tapered + twisted)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def naca_profile(chord, thickness_ratio=0.12, n=24):
    """Return closed list of App.Vector for a NACA 4-digit airfoil at z=0."""
    pts_upper = []
    pts_lower = []
    for k in range(n + 1):
        x = chord * (k / n)
        xn = x / chord  # normalised 0..1
        if xn < 0:
            xn = 0.0
        yt = (thickness_ratio * chord / 0.20) * (
            0.2969 * math.sqrt(xn)
            - 0.1260 * xn
            - 0.3516 * xn ** 2
            + 0.2843 * xn ** 3
            - 0.1015 * xn ** 4
        )
        pts_upper.append(App.Vector(x, yt, 0))
        pts_lower.append(App.Vector(x, -yt, 0))
    # combine: upper LE→TE, lower TE→LE, close
    profile = pts_upper + list(reversed(pts_lower[:-1]))
    profile.append(profile[0])
    return profile

def make_blade_section(chord, thickness_ratio, z_height, twist_deg):
    """Create a single airfoil wire at given z, with twist applied."""
    pts = naca_profile(chord, thickness_ratio)
    # Centre chord at x=0 (leading edge at -chord/2)
    centred = [App.Vector(p.x - chord / 2, p.y, z_height) for p in pts]
    # Apply twist rotation about Z axis at this section
    cos_t = math.cos(math.radians(twist_deg))
    sin_t = math.sin(math.radians(twist_deg))
    twisted = []
    for p in centred:
        nx = p.x * cos_t - p.y * sin_t
        ny = p.x * sin_t + p.y * cos_t
        twisted.append(App.Vector(nx, ny, p.z))
    wire = Part.makePolygon(twisted)
    return wire

# Build blade via loft of 8 sections from root to tip
N_SECTIONS = 8
blade_sections = []
for s in range(N_SECTIONS):
    t = s / (N_SECTIONS - 1)          # 0 at root, 1 at tip
    chord = CHORD_ROOT * (1 - t) + CHORD_TIP * t
    thickness_ratio = 0.15 * (1 - t * 0.4)   # 15% root → 9% tip
    z = t * BLADE_LEN
    # Twist: 30° at root (pitch angle), reducing to 10° at tip
    twist = PITCH_DEG * (1 - t) + 10.0 * t
    wire = make_blade_section(chord, thickness_ratio, z, twist)
    blade_sections.append(wire)

blade_loft = Part.makeLoft(blade_sections, True, False)

# Root attachment tab – rectangular tenon that fits hub slot
root_tab = Part.makeBox(CHORD_ROOT, 18.0, 25.0,
                         App.Vector(-CHORD_ROOT / 2, -9.0, -25.0))
# Rotate tab by pitch angle so it aligns with loft root
root_tab.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), PITCH_DEG)
blade_with_tab = blade_loft.fuse(root_tab)

# Place 3 blades at 120° spacing, offset radially by hub radius
blade_objs = []
for i in range(N_BLADES):
    ang_deg = i * 120.0
    ang_rad = math.radians(ang_deg)

    b = blade_with_tab.copy()
    # Translate so root starts at hub edge
    b.translate(App.Vector(HUB_R, 0, 0))
    # Rotate around Z to blade angular position
    b.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), ang_deg)

    bobj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', f'Blade_{i+1}')
    bobj.Shape = b
    bobj.Label = f'Blade_{i+1}'
    bobj.Label2 = 'Material: Aluminum Alloy 6061-T6'
    assembly.addObject(bobj)
    blade_objs.append(bobj)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  SHAFT  (steel, with keyway)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Shaft extends below hub: from z = -SHAFT_LEN to z = HUB_T
shaft_cyl = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R, SHAFT_LEN + HUB_T,
                               App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN),
                               App.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Keyway: 18mm wide × 7mm deep × 80mm long (DIN 6885 for 60mm shaft)
KEY_W = 18.0
KEY_D = 7.0
KEY_L = 80.0
keyway = Part.makeBox(KEY_W, KEY_D, KEY_L,
                       App.Vector(-KEY_W / 2, SHAFT_R - KEY_D, -SHAFT_LEN / 2))
shaft_shape = shaft_cyl.cut(keyway)

# Shaft shoulder / step at hub face (z=0): 5mm fillet zone represented as
# a slightly larger cylinder ring for visual clarity
shoulder = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 4.0, 8.0,
                              App.Vector(0, 0, -8.0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
shaft_shape = shaft_shape.fuse(shoulder)

# Thread relief groove near shaft end (M60 thread area)
relief_groove = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R - 2.0, 5.0,
                                   App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 10.0),
                                   App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
# Cut a thin annular groove
groove_outer = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 0.1, 5.0,
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 10.0),
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
groove_inner = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R - 2.0, 5.0,
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 10.0),
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
annular_groove = groove_outer.cut(groove_inner)
shaft_shape = shaft_shape.cut(annular_groove)

shaft_obj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', 'Shaft')
shaft_obj.Shape = shaft_shape
shaft_obj.Label = 'Shaft'
shaft_obj.Label2 = 'Material: Steel AISI 4140'
assembly.addObject(shaft_obj)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.  MOUNTING FLANGE  (steel, 8× M10 bolt holes on 250mm BCD)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Flange disc
flange_disc = Part.makeCylinder(FLANGE_R, FLANGE_T,
                                 App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN - FLANGE_T),
                                 App.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Central bore matching shaft
flange_bore = Part.makeCylinder(SHAFT_R + 0.05, FLANGE_T + 2,
                                 App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN - FLANGE_T - 1),
                                 App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
flange_shape = flange_disc.cut(flange_bore)

# 8× M10 bolt holes (clearance dia = 11mm → radius 5.5mm)
for i in range(N_BOLTS):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / N_BOLTS)
    bx = BOLT_CIRCLE_R * math.cos(ang)
    by = BOLT_CIRCLE_R * math.sin(ang)
    bolt_hole = Part.makeCylinder(BOLT_R, FLANGE_T + 2,
                                   App.Vector(bx, by, -SHAFT_LEN - FLANGE_T - 1),
                                   App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    flange_shape = flange_shape.cut(bolt_hole)

# Chamfer / fillet relief on bolt hole edges (represented as countersink)
for i in range(N_BOLTS):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / N_BOLTS)
    bx = BOLT_CIRCLE_R * math.cos(ang)
    by = BOLT_CIRCLE_R * math.sin(ang)
    # Countersink cone approximated as slightly larger shallow cylinder
    csink = Part.makeCylinder(BOLT_R + 2.0, 3.0,
                               App.Vector(bx, by, -SHAFT_LEN - FLANGE_T - 1),
                               App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    flange_shape = flange_shape.cut(csink)

# Stiffening ribs on flange back face (8 radial ribs)
rib_shapes = []
for i in range(8):
    ang = math.radians(i * 45.0)
    rib = Part.makeBox(FLANGE_R - SHAFT_R - 5, 4.0, 8.0,
                        App.Vector(SHAFT_R + 2, -2.0,
                                   -SHAFT_LEN - FLANGE_T - 1))
    rib.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), math.degrees(ang))
    rib_shapes.append(rib)

# Fuse ribs in batches to avoid deep chain
batch1 = rib_shapes[0]
for r in rib_shapes[1:4]:
    batch1 = batch1.fuse(r)
batch2 = rib_shapes[4]
for r in rib_shapes[5:]:
    batch2 = batch2.fuse(r)
all_ribs = batch1.fuse(batch2)
flange_shape = flange_shape.fuse(all_ribs)

flange_obj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', 'Mounting_Flange')
flange_obj.Shape = flange_shape
flange_obj.Label = 'Mounting_Flange'
flange_obj.Label2 = 'Material: Steel AISI 1045'
assembly.addObject(flange_obj)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5.  HOUSING  (cylindrical shroud / bearing housing)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HOUSING_OD = 80.0   # outer radius
HOUSING_ID = 32.0   # inner bore radius (bearing seat)
HOUSING_LEN = 120.0

housing_outer = Part.makeCylinder(HOUSING_OD, HOUSING_LEN,
                                   App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 20),
                                   App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
housing_bore = Part.makeCylinder(HOUSING_ID, HOUSING_LEN + 2,
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 19),
                                  App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
housing_shape = housing_outer.cut(housing_bore)

# Bearing seat grooves (two deep-groove ball bearing seats, 20mm wide each)
for z_seat in [-SHAFT_LEN + 25, -SHAFT_LEN + 95]:
    seat_groove_outer = Part.makeCylinder(HOUSING_ID + 3.0, 20.0,
                                           App.Vector(0, 0, z_seat),
                                           App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    seat_groove_inner = Part.makeCylinder(HOUSING_ID, 20.0,
                                           App.Vector(0, 0, z_seat),
                                           App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    seat_groove = seat_groove_outer.cut(seat_groove_inner)
    housing_shape = housing_shape.cut(seat_groove)

# Oil drain hole at bottom
drain = Part.makeCylinder(5.0, HOUSING_OD * 2,
                           App.Vector(-5, -HOUSING_OD - 1, -SHAFT_LEN + 60),
                           App.Vector(0, 1, 0))
housing_shape = housing_shape.cut(drain)

# 4× mounting lugs on housing OD
lug_shapes = []
for i in range(4):
    ang = math.radians(i * 90.0)
    lug = Part.makeBox(20.0, 15.0, 20.0,
                        App.Vector(HOUSING_OD - 2, -7.5, -SHAFT_LEN + 50))
    lug.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), math.degrees(ang))
    # M8 bolt hole through lug
    lug_bolt = Part.makeCylinder(4.5, 20.0,
                                  App.Vector(HOUSING_OD + 5, 0, -SHAFT_LEN + 55))
    lug_bolt.rotate(App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), math.degrees(ang))
    lug = lug.cut(lug_bolt)
    lug_shapes.append(lug)

lug_batch1 = lug_shapes[0].fuse(lug_shapes[1])
lug_batch2 = lug_shapes[2].fuse(lug_shapes[3])
all_lugs = lug_batch1.fuse(lug_batch2)
housing_shape = housing_shape.fuse(all_lugs)

housing_obj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', 'Housing')
housing_obj.Shape = housing_shape
housing_obj.Label = 'Housing'
housing_obj.Label2 = 'Material: Steel AISI 4140'
assembly.addObject(housing_obj)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Final recompute
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
doc.recompute()
